def _equipment_write_db_v5():
    import db as _db_module
    return _db_module


def _equipment_write_sync_hp_v5(user_id):
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    sync = getattr(db, "sync_user_max_hp", None)
    if callable(sync):
        try:
            return sync(int(user_id), heal_to_full=False)
        except TypeError:
            return sync(int(user_id))
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None


def _equipment_write_ensure_slots_v5(user_id):
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    uid = int(user_id)
    db.conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment_slots ("
        "user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, slot_key TEXT NOT NULL, inventory_id INTEGER, "
        "PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot_key))"
    )
    for slot_key in _EQUIPMENT_WRITE_SLOT_ORDER_V5:
        db.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO equipment_slots (user_id, slot_key, inventory_id) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, NULL)",
            (uid, slot_key),
        )
    db.conn.commit()


def _equipment_write_get_slot_v5(user_id, slot_key):
    _equipment_write_ensure_slots_v5(user_id)
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    row = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT inventory_id FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key=?",
        (int(user_id), str(slot_key)),
    ).fetchone()
    return int(row[0]) if row and row[0] is not None else None


def _equipment_write_set_slot_v5(user_id, slot_key, inventory_id):
    _equipment_write_ensure_slots_v5(user_id)
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    db.conn.execute(
        "UPDATE equipment_slots SET inventory_id=? WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key=?",
        (int(inventory_id) if inventory_id is not None else None, int(user_id), str(slot_key)),
    )
    db.conn.commit()


def _equipment_write_find_slot_v5(user_id, inventory_id):
    _equipment_write_ensure_slots_v5(user_id)
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    row = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT slot_key FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND inventory_id=? LIMIT 1",
        (int(user_id), int(inventory_id)),
    ).fetchone()
    return str(row[0]) if row else None


def _equipment_write_item_v5(user_id, inventory_id):
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    row = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT inv.id, inv.user_id, inv.item_id, COALESCE(inv.durability,100), "
        "COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0), it.name, it.category, it.slot_key, "
        "COALESCE(it.weapon_hands,1), COALESCE(it.item_level,1), "
        "COALESCE(it.item_subtype,''), COALESCE(it.armor_type,'') "
        "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE inv.id=? AND inv.user_id=?",
        (int(inventory_id), int(user_id)),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None
    keys = (
        "inventory_id", "user_id", "item_id", "durability", "refine_level",
        "name", "category", "slot_key", "weapon_hands", "item_level",
        "item_subtype", "armor_type",
    )
    result = dict(zip(keys, row))
    try:
        display = get_inventory_refined_display_name(int(inventory_id), result["name"])
        if display:
            result["name"] = display
    except Exception:
        pass
    return result


def _equipment_write_required_level_v5(inventory_id, fallback=1):
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    row = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(it.item_level, ?) FROM inventory inv "
        "JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id WHERE inv.id=?",
        (int(fallback), int(inventory_id)),
    ).fetchone()
    try:
        return max(1, int(row[0] if row else fallback))
    except Exception:
        return max(1, int(fallback or 1))


def _equipment_write_player_level_v5(user_id):
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    row = db.conn.execute("SELECT level FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),)).fetchone()
    return max(1, int(row[0] if row else 1))


def _equipment_write_main_hand_two_handed_v5(user_id):
    inventory_id = _equipment_write_get_slot_v5(user_id, "main_hand")
    if not inventory_id:
        return False
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    row = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(it.weapon_hands,1) FROM inventory inv "
        "JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id WHERE inv.id=?",
        (int(inventory_id),),
    ).fetchone()
    return bool(row and int(row[0] or 1) == 2)


def equip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    """Direct SQL equip implementation preserving the historical string contract."""
    uid = int(user_id)
    iid = int(inventory_id)
    item = _equipment_write_item_v5(uid, iid)

    if not item:
        return "❌ Предмет не знайдено"
    if item.get("category") != "equipment":
        return "❌ Цей предмет не можна одягти"

    slot_key = str(item.get("slot_key") or "")
    if not slot_key:
        return "❌ Для цього предмета не вказано слот"
    if slot_key not in _EQUIPMENT_WRITE_SLOT_ORDER_V5:
        return "❌ Невідомий слот екіпірування"

    player_level = _equipment_write_player_level_v5(uid)
    required_level = _equipment_write_required_level_v5(iid, item.get("item_level", 1))
    if player_level < required_level:
        return (
            "🔒 Ти ще не можеш одягти цей предмет.\n\n"
            f"📦 Предмет: {item['name']}\n"
            f"🏷 Потрібний рівень: {required_level}\n"
            f"👤 Твій рівень: {player_level}"
        )

    class_check = can_equip_inventory_item_by_class(uid, iid)
    if isinstance(class_check, dict) and not class_check.get("success"):
        return class_check.get("message", "❌ Цей предмет не підходить твоєму класу.")

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and _equipment_write_main_hand_two_handed_v5(uid):
        return "❌ Неможливо: дворучна зброя блокує другу руку"

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and int(item.get("weapon_hands") or 1) == 2:
        _equipment_write_set_slot_v5(uid, "off_hand", None)

    # One inventory row may occupy only one slot.
    old_slot = _equipment_write_find_slot_v5(uid, iid)
    if old_slot and old_slot != slot_key:
        _equipment_write_set_slot_v5(uid, old_slot, None)

    _equipment_write_set_slot_v5(uid, slot_key, iid)
    _equipment_write_sync_hp_v5(uid)
    return f"✅ Одягнуто: {item['name']}"


def unequip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    """Direct SQL unequip implementation preserving the historical string contract."""
    uid = int(user_id)
    iid = int(inventory_id)
    slot_key = _equipment_write_find_slot_v5(uid, iid)
    if not slot_key:
        return "❌ Цей предмет не вдягнений"
    _equipment_write_set_slot_v5(uid, slot_key, None)
    _equipment_write_sync_hp_v5(uid)
    return f"✅ Знято зі слота: {_EQUIPMENT_WRITE_SLOT_LABELS_V5.get(slot_key, slot_key)}"


def _equipment_write_reason_v5(item_info, message=""):
    lowered = str(message or "").lower()
    slot_key = str((item_info or {}).get("slot_key") or "")
    if "дворуч" in lowered:
        return "конфлікт із дворучною зброєю"
    if slot_key in {"helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"}:
        return "броня не підходить класу"
    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        return "зброя не підходить класу"
    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        return "предмет для другої руки не підходить класу"
    return "не підходить новому класу"


def _equipment_write_display_name_v5(item_info, inventory_id):
    name = str((item_info or {}).get("name") or "Невідомий предмет")
    armor_type = str((item_info or {}).get("armor_type") or "")
    slot_key = str((item_info or {}).get("slot_key") or "")
    if slot_key in {"helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"} and armor_type:
        label = _EQUIPMENT_WRITE_ARMOR_LABELS_V5.get(armor_type, armor_type)
        if label and f"[{label}]" not in name:
            marker = " рівня"
            if marker in name:
                index = name.rfind(marker)
                before, after = name[:index], name[index:]
                parts = before.rsplit(" ", 1)
                if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
                    name = f"{parts[0]} [{label}] {parts[1]}{after}"
                else:
                    name = f"{name} [{label}]"
            else:
                name = f"{name} [{label}]"
    try:
        refined = get_inventory_refined_display_name(int(inventory_id), name)
        if refined:
            name = refined
    except Exception:
        pass
    return name


def unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id):
    """Direct slot updates; compatibility rules remain in the read-only domain."""
    uid = int(user_id)
    _equipment_write_ensure_slots_v5(uid)
    db = _equipment_write_db_v5()
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT slot_key, inventory_id FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=?",
        (uid,),
    ).fetchall()

    removed_items = []
    for slot_key, inventory_id in rows:
        if inventory_id is None:
            continue
        try:
            compatibility = can_equip_inventory_item_by_class(uid, int(inventory_id))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if isinstance(compatibility, dict) and compatibility.get("success"):
            continue
        if not isinstance(compatibility, dict):
            continue

        item_info = None
        classifier = getattr(db, "get_item_classification_by_inventory_id", None)
        if callable(classifier):
            try:
                item_info = classifier(int(inventory_id))
            except Exception:
                item_info = None
        if not isinstance(item_info, dict):
            raw = _equipment_write_item_v5(uid, int(inventory_id)) or {}
            item_info = {
                "name": raw.get("name"),
                "slot_key": raw.get("slot_key"),
                "armor_type": raw.get("armor_type"),
                "item_subtype": raw.get("item_subtype"),
            }

        reason = _equipment_write_reason_v5(item_info, compatibility.get("message", ""))
        display_name = _equipment_write_display_name_v5(item_info, int(inventory_id))
        _equipment_write_set_slot_v5(uid, str(slot_key), None)
        removed_items.append({
            "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),
            "slot_key": str(slot_key),
            "name": f"{display_name} — {reason}",
            "reason": reason,
        })

    _equipment_write_sync_hp_v5(uid)
    return {
        "success": True,
        "removed_items": removed_items,
        "removed_count": len(removed_items),
    }

_REPAIR_MULTIPLIERS_9_0_12H2 = {
    "common": 1.0,
    "uncommon": 2.5,
    "rare": 7.0,
    "epic": 18.0,

def _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inventory_id, base_name):
    try:
        func = globals().get("get_inventory_refined_display_name")
        if callable(func):
            value = func(int(inventory_id))
            if value:
                return str(value)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return str(base_name or "Предмет")


def get_rarity_repair_multiplier(rarity):
    return float(_REPAIR_MULTIPLIERS_9_0_12H2.get(str(rarity or "common").lower(), 1.0))


def calculate_repair_cost(durability, rarity):
    try:
        durability = int(100 if durability is None else durability)
    except Exception:
        durability = 100
    durability = max(0, min(100, durability))
    if durability >= 100:
        return 0.0
    return round((100 - durability) * get_rarity_repair_multiplier(rarity) * 0.05, 2)


def _equipment_slot_rows_9_0_12h2(user_id):
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    db.conn.row_factory = __import__("sqlite3").Row
    return db.conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT es.slot_key,
               es.inventory_id,
               inv.item_id,
               inv.durability,
               COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0) AS refine_level,
               i.name,
               i.rarity
        FROM equipment_slots es
        LEFT JOIN inventory inv
          ON inv.id = es.inventory_id
         AND inv.user_id = es.user_id
        LEFT JOIN items i
          ON i.id = inv.item_id
        WHERE es.user_id=?
        ORDER BY CASE es.slot_key
            WHEN 'main_hand' THEN 1
            WHEN 'off_hand' THEN 2
            WHEN 'helmet' THEN 3
            WHEN 'shoulders' THEN 4
            WHEN 'chest' THEN 5
            WHEN 'gloves' THEN 6
            WHEN 'legs' THEN 7
            WHEN 'boots' THEN 8
            WHEN 'necklace' THEN 9
            WHEN 'ring' THEN 10
            ELSE 99 END
        """,
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchall()


_SLOT_NAMES_9_0_12H2 = {
    "main_hand": "Основна рука",
    "off_hand": "Друга рука",
    "helmet": "Шолом",
    "shoulders": "Наплічники",
    "chest": "Обладунок",
    "gloves": "Рукавиці",
    "legs": "Поножі",
    "boots": "Чоботи",
    "necklace": "Намисто",
    "ring": "Перстень",
}


def get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id):
    result = []
    for row in _equipment_slot_rows_9_0_12h2(user_id):
        slot_key = row["slot_key"]
        inventory_id = row["inventory_id"]
        slot_name = _SLOT_NAMES_9_0_12H2.get(slot_key, slot_key)

        if not inventory_id:
            result.append({
                "slot": slot_name,
                "slot_name": slot_name,
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "inventory_id": None,
                "name": "Порожньо",
                "rarity": None,
                "durability": None,
                "repair_cost": 0.0,
                "is_broken": False,
                "refine_level": 0,
            })
            continue

        durability = 100 if row["durability"] is None else max(0, min(100, int(row["durability"])))
        rarity = str(row["rarity"] or "common")
        name = _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inventory_id, row["name"])
        result.append({
            "slot": slot_name,
            "slot_name": slot_name,
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),
            "item_id": int(row["item_id"]),
            "name": name,
            "rarity": rarity,
            "durability": durability,
            "repair_cost": calculate_repair_cost(durability, rarity),
            "is_broken": durability <= 0,
            "refine_level": int(row["refine_level"] or 0),
        })
    return result


def get_total_repair_cost(user_id):
    return round(sum(float(x.get("repair_cost", 0.0) or 0.0) for x in get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id)), 2)


def _equipment_wallet_9_0_12h2(db, user_id):
    row = db.conn.execute("SELECT gold FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),)).fetchone()
    return float(row[0] or 0.0) if row else 0.0


def repair_equipped_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    user_id = int(user_id)
    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)
    row = db.conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT inv.durability, COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0), i.name, i.rarity
        FROM equipment_slots es
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id
        JOIN items i ON i.id=inv.item_id
        WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id=?
        LIMIT 1
        """,
        (user_id, inventory_id),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей предмет не вдягнений або не належить персонажу."}

    old_durability = 100 if row[0] is None else max(0, min(100, int(row[0])))
    name = _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inventory_id, row[2])
    rarity = str(row[3] or "common")
    cost = calculate_repair_cost(old_durability, rarity)
    if old_durability >= 100 or cost <= 0:
        return {"success": False, "message": f"ℹ️ {name} уже має максимальну міцність.", "inventory_id": inventory_id}

    try:
        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        wallet = _equipment_wallet_9_0_12h2(db, user_id)
        if wallet + 1e-9 < cost:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Недостатньо золота. Потрібно: {cost:.2f} 💰"}
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=gold-? WHERE user_id=?", (cost, user_id))
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=100 WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (inventory_id, user_id))
        db.conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.conn.rollback()
        raise

    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)
    message = (
        "✅ Предмет відремонтовано.\n\n"
        f"📦 {name}\n"
        f"🛠️ Міцність: {old_durability}/100 → 100/100\n"
        f"💳 Сплачено: {cost:.2f} 💰 золото"
    )
    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": message,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "name": name,
        "old_durability": old_durability,
        "new_durability": 100,
        "cost": cost,
    }


def repair_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    return repair_equipped_item(user_id, inventory_id)


def repair_all_equipped(user_id):
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    user_id = int(user_id)
    items = [x for x in get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id) if x.get("inventory_id") and int(x.get("durability") or 0) < 100]
    if not items:
        return {"success": False, "message": "ℹ️ Усе вдягнене спорядження вже відремонтоване."}
    total = round(sum(float(x["repair_cost"]) for x in items), 2)
    try:
        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        wallet = _equipment_wallet_9_0_12h2(db, user_id)
        if wallet + 1e-9 < total:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Недостатньо золота. Потрібно: {total:.2f} 💰"}
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=gold-? WHERE user_id=?", (total, user_id))
        db.conn.executemany(
            "UPDATE inventory SET durability=100 WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
            [(int(x["inventory_id"]), user_id) for x in items],
        )
        db.conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.conn.rollback()
        raise
    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)
    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            "✅ Усе спорядження відремонтовано.\n\n"
            f"📦 Відремонтовано предметів: {len(items)}\n"
            f"💳 Сплачено: {total:.2f} 💰 золото"
        ),
        "count": len(items),
        "cost": total,
        "items": items,
    }


def set_inventory_item_durability(inventory_id, durability, user_id=None):
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)
    durability = max(0, min(100, int(durability)))
    if user_id is None:
        owner = db.conn.execute("SELECT user_id FROM inventory WHERE id=?", (inventory_id,)).fetchone()
        if not owner:
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено."}
        user_id = int(owner[0])
    cur = db.conn.execute(
        "UPDATE inventory SET durability=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
        (durability, inventory_id, int(user_id)),
    )
    db.conn.commit()
    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)
    return {"success": cur.rowcount > 0, "inventory_id": inventory_id, "durability": durability}


def damage_equipped_items(user_id, amount=1):
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    user_id = int(user_id)
    amount = max(0, int(amount or 0))
    if amount <= 0:
        return {"success": True, "damaged": 0, "amount": 0, "items": []}
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT inv.id, COALESCE(inv.durability, 100), i.name
        FROM equipment_slots es
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id
        JOIN items i ON i.id=inv.item_id
        WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
        """,
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    changed = []
    try:
        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        for inv_id, old_value, base_name in rows:
            old_value = max(0, min(100, int(old_value or 0)))
            new_value = max(0, old_value - amount)
            if new_value == old_value:
                continue
            db.conn.execute("UPDATE inventory SET durability=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?", (new_value, int(inv_id), user_id))
            changed.append({
                "inventory_id": int(inv_id),
                "name": _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inv_id, base_name),
                "old_durability": old_value,
                "new_durability": new_value,
                "is_broken": new_value <= 0,
            })
        db.conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.conn.rollback()
        raise
    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)
    return {"success": True, "damaged": len(changed), "amount": amount, "items": changed}


def damage_equipped_items_on_death(user_id, amount=5):
    return damage_equipped_items(user_id, amount=5)


def reduce_equipped_item_durability(user_id, inventory_id, amount=1):
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    row = db.conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT COALESCE(inv.durability,100)
        FROM equipment_slots es
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id
        WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id=?
        """,
        (int(user_id), int(inventory_id)),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Вдягнений предмет не знайдено."}
    old_value = max(0, min(100, int(row[0] or 0)))
    new_value = max(0, old_value - max(0, int(amount or 0)))
    result = set_inventory_item_durability(inventory_id, new_value, user_id=user_id)
    result.update({"old_durability": old_value, "new_durability": new_value, "is_broken": new_value <= 0})
    return result


def apply_equipment_wear(user_id, amount=1):
    return damage_equipped_items(user_id, amount=amount)


def apply_equipment_wear_after_combat(user_id, amount=1):
    return damage_equipped_items(user_id, amount=amount)


def apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(user_id, chance=None, amount=1):
    """Зберігає старий принцип: за успішного roll зношується один випадковий вдягнений предмет."""
    import random
    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    if chance is None:
        chance = float(getattr(db, "DURABILITY_WEAR_CHANCE", 0.25))
    chance = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(chance)))
    if random.random() >= chance:
        return {"success": True, "worn": False, "damaged": 0, "items": []}
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT inv.id
        FROM equipment_slots es
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id
        WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(inv.durability,100)>0
        """,
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchall()
    if not rows:
        return {"success": True, "worn": False, "damaged": 0, "items": []}
    inventory_id = int(random.choice(rows)[0])
    result = reduce_equipped_item_durability(user_id, inventory_id, amount=amount)
    return {"success": bool(result.get("success")), "worn": True, "damaged": 1, "items": [result], "inventory_id": inventory_id}


def roll_equipment_wear_after_combat(user_id, chance=None, amount=1):
    return apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(user_id, chance=chance, amount=amount)

def damage_equipped_items_on_death(user_id, amount=5):
    """
    Historical public contract used by handlers/combat.py:
    list[dict] with name, old, new and broken.

    The gameplay rule is fixed at -5 durability for every equipped item.
    The amount argument remains accepted for API compatibility.
    """
    result = damage_equipped_items(user_id, amount=5)
    items = result.get("items", []) if isinstance(result, dict) else []
    return [
        {
            "name": str(item.get("name") or "Предмет"),
            "old": int(item.get("old_durability", 0) or 0),
            "new": int(item.get("new_durability", 0) or 0),
            "broken": bool(item.get("is_broken", False)),
        }
        for item in items
        if isinstance(item, dict)
    ]


def apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(user_id, chance_percent=25, **kwargs):
    """
    Historical public contract used by build_victory_text():
    {triggered: bool, message: str | None}.

    On a successful roll exactly one equipped, non-broken item loses 1 durability.
    """
    import random

    try:
        chance_percent = int(chance_percent)
    except Exception:
        chance_percent = 25
    chance_percent = max(0, min(100, chance_percent))

    roll = random.randint(1, 100)
    if roll > chance_percent:
        return {"triggered": False, "message": None}

    db = _equipment_db_9_0_12h2()
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT es.slot_key, inv.id, COALESCE(inv.durability,100), it.name "
        "FROM equipment_slots es "
        "JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id "
        "JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE es.user_id=? AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL "
        "AND COALESCE(inv.durability,100)>0",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchall()

    if not rows:
        return {"triggered": False, "message": None}

    slot_key, inventory_id, old_durability, base_name = random.choice(rows)
    old_durability = max(0, min(100, int(old_durability or 0)))
    new_durability = max(0, old_durability - 1)

    db.conn.execute(
        "UPDATE inventory SET durability=? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
        (new_durability, int(inventory_id), int(user_id)),
    )
    db.conn.commit()
    _equipment_sync_hp_9_0_12h2(user_id)

    name = _equipment_display_name_9_0_12h2(inventory_id, base_name)
    slot_name = _SLOT_NAMES_9_0_12H2.get(str(slot_key), str(slot_key))
    broken_text = " Предмет зламано!" if new_durability <= 0 else ""
    message = (
        f"🧱 {slot_name}: {name} втратив 1 міцності "
        f"({old_durability} → {new_durability}/100).{broken_text}"
    )
    return {
        "triggered": True,
        "message": message,
        "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),
        "name": name,
        "slot_key": str(slot_key),
        "old": old_durability,
        "new": new_durability,
        "broken": new_durability <= 0,
    }


def roll_equipment_wear_after_combat(user_id, chance_percent=25, **kwargs):
    return apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(
        user_id,
        chance_percent=chance_percent,
        **kwargs,
    )

_TRADER_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS_9_0_12H3 = (
    "main_hand", "off_hand", "helmet", "shoulders", "chest",
    "gloves", "legs", "boots", "necklace", "ring",

def _trader_db_9_0_12h3():
    import db
    return db


def _trader_wallet_9_0_12h3(db, user_id):
    row = db.conn.execute("SELECT gold FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),)).fetchone()
    return float(row[0] or 0.0) if row else 0.0


def _trader_bag_state_9_0_12h3(db, user_id):
    row = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(bag_slots,40) FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchone()
    capacity = int(row[0] or 40) if row else 40
    used = int(db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchone()[0] or 0)
    return used, capacity


def _trader_display_name_9_0_12h3(inventory_id, base_name):
    try:
        value = get_inventory_refined_display_name(int(inventory_id), base_name)
        if value:
            return str(value)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return str(base_name or "Предмет")


def get_sellable_equipment_items(user_id):
    """Historical 19-field tuple list, excluding every currently equipped row."""
    db = _trader_db_9_0_12h3()
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT inv.id, inv.item_id, it.name, it.type, it.rarity, it.category, "
        "it.slot_key, COALESCE(it.weapon_hands,1), COALESCE(inv.quantity,1), "
        "COALESCE(it.max_stack,1), COALESCE(inv.durability,100), "
        "COALESCE(it.bonus_str,0), COALESCE(it.bonus_dex,0), "
        "COALESCE(it.bonus_int,0), COALESCE(it.bonus_wis,0), "
        "COALESCE(it.bonus_sta,0), COALESCE(it.pdef,0), COALESCE(it.mdef,0), "
        "COALESCE(it.sell_price,0) "
        "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE inv.user_id=? AND it.category='equipment' "
        "AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM equipment_slots es "
        "                WHERE es.user_id=inv.user_id AND es.inventory_id=inv.id) "
        "ORDER BY inv.id ASC",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchall()
    result = []
    for row in rows:
        values = list(row)
        values[2] = _trader_display_name_9_0_12h3(values[0], values[2])
        result.append(tuple(values))
    return result


def sell_inventory_item_to_trader(user_id, inventory_id):
    """Atomically remove one owned, unequipped equipment row and credit its sell price."""
    db = _trader_db_9_0_12h3()
    uid = int(user_id)
    iid = int(inventory_id)
    try:
        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row = db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT inv.item_id, COALESCE(inv.quantity,1), COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0), "
            "it.name, it.category, COALESCE(it.sell_price,0) "
            "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
            "WHERE inv.id=? AND inv.user_id=?",
            (iid, uid),
        ).fetchone()
        if not row:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено або його вже продано."}
        item_id, quantity, refine_level, base_name, category, sell_price = row
        if category != "equipment":
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Торговець приймає тут лише спорядження."}
        equipped = db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND inventory_id=? LIMIT 1",
            (uid, iid),
        ).fetchone()
        if equipped:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Неможливо продати вдягнений предмет.\n\nСпочатку зніми його з персонажа.",
            }
        quantity = max(1, int(quantity or 1))
        earned = round(float(sell_price or 0.0) * quantity, 2)
        name = _trader_display_name_9_0_12h3(iid, base_name)
        deleted = db.conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
            (iid, uid),
        )
        if deleted.rowcount != 1:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Предмет уже продано. Золото не нараховано."}
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=COALESCE(gold,0)+? WHERE user_id=?", (earned, uid))
        db.conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.conn.rollback()
        raise
    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": f"✅ Продано: {name}\n💰 Отримано: {earned:.2f} золота",
        "inventory_id": iid,
        "item_id": int(item_id),
        "name": name,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "refine_level": int(refine_level or 0),
        "earned": earned,
        "sell_price": earned,
    }


def buy_item_for_gold(user_id, item_id, price, quantity=1):
    """Atomic generic purchase with wallet, stacking and bag-capacity checks."""
    db = _trader_db_9_0_12h3()
    uid = int(user_id)
    item_id = int(item_id)
    quantity = max(1, int(quantity or 1))
    price = round(max(0.0, float(price or 0.0)), 2)
    try:
        db.conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        item = db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT name, COALESCE(max_stack,1) FROM items WHERE id=?",
            (item_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not item:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Товар не знайдено."}
        name, max_stack = item
        wallet = _trader_wallet_9_0_12h3(db, uid)
        if wallet + 1e-9 < price:
            db.conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Недостатньо золота. Потрібно: {price:.2f} 💰"}

        max_stack = max(1, int(max_stack or 1))
        stack = None
        if max_stack > 1:
            stack = db.conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=? "
                "AND quantity<? ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1",
                (uid, item_id, max_stack),
            ).fetchone()
        if stack and int(stack[1] or 0) + quantity <= max_stack:
            db.conn.execute(
                "UPDATE inventory SET quantity=quantity+? WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
                (quantity, int(stack[0]), uid),
            )
            inventory_id = int(stack[0])
        else:
            used, capacity = _trader_bag_state_9_0_12h3(db, uid)
            if used >= capacity:
                db.conn.rollback()
                return {"success": False, "message": "❌ У сумці немає вільного місця."}
            cur = db.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO inventory (user_id,item_id,quantity,durability,refine_level) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,100,0)",
                (uid, item_id, quantity),
            )
            inventory_id = int(cur.lastrowid)
        db.conn.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=gold-? WHERE user_id=?", (price, uid))
        db.conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        db.conn.rollback()
        raise
    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": f"✅ Куплено: {name} ×{quantity}\n💳 Сплачено: {price:.2f} 💰 золота",
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "price": price,
        "name": str(name),
    }


def buy_common_equipment_from_trader(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    """
    Preserve the direct-buy API while using the established preview workflow.
    Preview ownership, class restrictions, price and item generation remain validated
    by the existing preview functions; confirmation is still a single purchase action.
    """
    db = _trader_db_9_0_12h3()
    uid = int(user_id)
    slot_key = str(slot_key or "")
    if slot_key not in _TRADER_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS_9_0_12H3:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Невідомий слот спорядження."}

    allowed = getattr(db, "is_shop_profile_allowed_for_user", None)
    if item_profile and callable(allowed):
        try:
            if not allowed(uid, slot_key, item_profile):
                return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей тип спорядження не підходить твоєму класу."}
        except Exception:
            pass

    create_preview = getattr(db, "create_common_equipment_shop_preview", None)
    confirm_preview = getattr(db, "confirm_common_equipment_shop_preview", None)
    if not callable(create_preview) or not callable(confirm_preview):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Магазин спорядження тимчасово недоступний."}

    preview = create_preview(uid, slot_key, item_profile)
    if isinstance(preview, dict) and not preview.get("success", True):
        return preview
    if isinstance(preview, dict):
        preview_id = preview.get("item_id") or preview.get("preview_item_id") or preview.get("id")
    else:
        preview_id = preview
    if not preview_id:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Не вдалося створити товар магазину."}
    return confirm_preview(uid, int(preview_id))

def now_iso():
    return datetime.now().isoformat()


def get_current_guild_season_key():
    """
    Поточний місячний сезон рейтингу гільдій.
    Формат: YYYY-MM
    """

    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m")


def normalize_guild_name(value):
    return (value or "").strip().casefold()


def normalize_guild_tag(value):
    return (value or "").strip().upper()


def calculate_guild_score(exp=0, resource=0, kills=0, contracts=0):
    """
    Єдина формула score для рейтингу.

    Стартова проста формула:
    score = exp + resource + kills + contracts * 25

    Її можна буде змінити пізніше без перебудови таблиць.
    """

    exp = int(exp or 0)
    resource = int(resource or 0)
    kills = int(kills or 0)
    contracts = int(contracts or 0)

    return exp + resource + kills + contracts * 25

def init_guild_system():
    """
    Ініціалізує таблиці гільдій.

    Безпечна для багаторазового виклику.
    """

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guilds (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        name_norm TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        tag TEXT NOT NULL,
        tag_norm TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        icon TEXT DEFAULT '🏰',
        leader_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        level INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        exp INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        resource INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        member_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 30,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,

        monthly_exp INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_resource INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_kills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_contracts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

        total_exp INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        total_resource INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        total_kills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        total_contracts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        total_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

        season_key TEXT NOT NULL
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_members (
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
        joined_at TEXT NOT NULL,

        contribution_exp INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        contribution_resource INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        contribution_kills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        contribution_contracts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        contribution_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

        monthly_contribution_exp INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_contribution_resource INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_contribution_kills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_contribution_contracts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_contribution_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

        PRIMARY KEY (guild_id, user_id)
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_applications (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        processed_at TEXT,
        processed_by INTEGER,
        UNIQUE (guild_id, user_id, status)
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_logs (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        text TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guild_season_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        guild_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        season_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        monthly_exp INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_resource INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_kills INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_contracts INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        monthly_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        finished_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        UNIQUE (guild_id, season_key)
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guilds_monthly_score ON guilds(monthly_score DESC)")
    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guilds_total_score ON guilds(total_score DESC)")
    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guild_members_user ON guild_members(user_id)")
    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guild_members_guild ON guild_members(guild_id)")
    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guild_applications_guild_status ON guild_applications(guild_id, status)")
    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guild_logs_guild_created ON guild_logs(guild_id, created_at DESC)")
    cursor.execute("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guild_season_history_season ON guild_season_history(season_key, monthly_score DESC)")

    conn.commit()

    ensure_all_guild_monthly_seasons()


# ==============================
# ✅ MONTHLY SEASON RESET
# ==============================

def archive_and_reset_guild_monthly_stats(guild_row, new_season_key=None):
    """
    Архівує минулий місяць у guild_season_history і обнуляє monthly counters.
    """

    if not guild_row:
        return False

    if new_season_key is None:
        new_season_key = get_current_guild_season_key()

    guild_id = guild_row["id"]
    old_season_key = guild_row["season_key"]

    if old_season_key == new_season_key:
        return False

    finished_at = now_iso()

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO guild_season_history (
        guild_id,
        season_key,
        monthly_exp,
        monthly_resource,
        monthly_kills,
        monthly_contracts,
        monthly_score,
        finished_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        old_season_key,
        int(guild_row["monthly_exp"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_resource"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_kills"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_contracts"] or 0),
        int(guild_row["monthly_score"] or 0),
        finished_at,
    ))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guilds
    SET monthly_exp=0,
        monthly_resource=0,
        monthly_kills=0,
        monthly_contracts=0,
        monthly_score=0,
        season_key=?,
        updated_at=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        new_season_key,
        finished_at,
        guild_id,
    ))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guild_members
    SET monthly_contribution_exp=0,
        monthly_contribution_resource=0,
        monthly_contribution_kills=0,
        monthly_contribution_contracts=0,
        monthly_contribution_score=0
    WHERE guild_id=?
    """, (
        guild_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="season_reset",
        text=f"Почався новий сезон рейтингу: {new_season_key}. Попередній сезон {old_season_key} збережено в історії."
    )

    return True


def ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild_id):
    init_guild_system_tables_only()

    current_season = get_current_guild_season_key()
    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id, ensure_season=False)

    if not guild:
        return False

    return archive_and_reset_guild_monthly_stats(guild, current_season)


def ensure_all_guild_monthly_seasons():
    init_guild_system_tables_only()

    current_season = get_current_guild_season_key()

    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM guilds WHERE season_key != ?", (current_season,))
    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for row in rows:
        archive_and_reset_guild_monthly_stats(row, current_season)

    return len(rows)


def init_guild_system_tables_only():
    """
    Легка перевірка, щоб helper-и могли викликатись після першої ініціалізації
    без рекурсії init_guild_system() -> ensure -> init.
    """

    # Нічого не робимо: таблиці створюються через init_guild_system().
    # Функція залишена як явний marker для безпечних викликів.
    return True

# ✅ GUILD CRUD

def add_guild_log(guild_id, event_type, text):
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO guild_logs (guild_id, event_type, text, created_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        event_type,
        text,
        now_iso(),
    ))

    conn.commit()


def get_guild_by_id(guild_id, ensure_season=True):
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM guilds WHERE id=?", (guild_id,))
    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if row and ensure_season:
        if row["season_key"] != get_current_guild_season_key():
            ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild_id)
            cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM guilds WHERE id=?", (guild_id,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()

    return row


def get_guild_by_name_or_tag(value):
    name_norm = normalize_guild_name(value)
    tag_norm = normalize_guild_tag(value)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT * FROM guilds
    WHERE name_norm=? OR tag_norm=?
    """, (
        name_norm,
        tag_norm,
    ))

    return cursor.fetchone()


def is_user_in_guild(user_id):
    cursor.execute("SELECT 1 FROM guild_members WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    return cursor.fetchone() is not None


def get_user_guild_member(user_id):
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM guild_members WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    return cursor.fetchone()


def get_user_guild(user_id):
    member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)

    if not member:
        return None

    return get_guild_by_id(member["guild_id"])


def get_user_guild_role(user_id):
    member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)

    if not member:
        return None

    return member["role"]


def validate_guild_create_input(name, tag, icon="🏰"):
    name = (name or "").strip()
    tag = normalize_guild_tag(tag)
    icon = (icon or "🏰").strip() or "🏰"

    if len(name) < 3:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Назва гільдії має містити мінімум 3 символи."
        }

    if len(name) > 32:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Назва гільдії має бути не довша за 32 символи."
        }

    if len(tag) < 2:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Абревіатура гільдії має містити мінімум 2 символи."
        }

    if len(tag) > 5:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Абревіатура гільдії має бути не довша за 5 символів."
        }

    existing = get_guild_by_name_or_tag(name)

    if existing:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гільдія з такою назвою або абревіатурою вже існує."
        }

    existing_tag = get_guild_by_name_or_tag(tag)

    if existing_tag:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гільдія з такою назвою або абревіатурою вже існує."
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "name": name,
        "tag": tag,
        "icon": icon,
    }


def create_guild(user_id, name, tag, icon="🏰"):
    """
    Створює гільдію.

    На 7.0.1 створення безкоштовне.
    Вартість можна додати пізніше через GUILD_CREATE_COST_GOLD.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    if is_user_in_guild(user_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Ти вже перебуваєш у гільдії."
        }

    validation = validate_guild_create_input(name, tag, icon)

    if not validation.get("success"):
        return validation

    now = now_iso()
    season_key = get_current_guild_season_key()

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO guilds (
        name,
        name_norm,
        tag,
        tag_norm,
        icon,
        leader_user_id,
        level,
        exp,
        resource,
        member_limit,
        created_at,
        updated_at,
        season_key
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 0, 0, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        validation["name"],
        normalize_guild_name(validation["name"]),
        validation["tag"],
        normalize_guild_tag(validation["tag"]),
        validation["icon"],
        user_id,
        DEFAULT_GUILD_MEMBER_LIMIT,
        now,
        now,
        season_key,
    ))

    guild_id = cursor.lastrowid

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO guild_members (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        role,
        joined_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_ROLE_LEADER,
        now,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="guild_created",
        text=f"Гільдію {validation['icon']} [{validation['tag']}] {validation['name']} створено."
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "guild_id": guild_id,
        "message": f"✅ Гільдію {validation['icon']} [{validation['tag']}] {validation['name']} створено."
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ MEMBERS
# ==============================

def get_guild_members(guild_id):
    ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gm.*,
           users.character_name,
           users.level
    FROM guild_members gm
    LEFT JOIN users ON users.user_id = gm.user_id
    WHERE gm.guild_id=?
    ORDER BY
        CASE gm.role
            WHEN 'leader' THEN 1
            WHEN 'officer' THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END,
        gm.contribution_score DESC,
        gm.joined_at ASC
    """, (
        guild_id,
    ))

    return cursor.fetchall()


def get_guild_member_count(guild_id):
    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=?", (guild_id,))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    return int(row["cnt"] if row else 0)


def can_manage_guild_applications(user_id, guild_id):
    member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)

    if not member:
        return False

    if int(member["guild_id"]) != int(guild_id):
        return False

    return member["role"] in [GUILD_ROLE_LEADER, GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER]


# ==============================
# ✅ APPLICATIONS CORE
# ==============================

def create_guild_application(user_id, guild_id):
    init_guild_system()

    if is_user_in_guild(user_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Ти вже перебуваєш у гільдії."
        }

    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)

    if not guild:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гільдію не знайдено."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT * FROM guild_applications
    WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=? AND status=?
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
    ))

    if cursor.fetchone():
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "ℹ️ Ти вже подав заявку в цю гільдію."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO guild_applications (guild_id, user_id, status, created_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
        now_iso(),
    ))

    conn.commit()

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="application_created",
        text=f"Нова заявка до гільдії від user_id={user_id}."
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "✅ Заявку до гільдії подано."
    }


def get_guild_applications(guild_id, status=GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT ga.*,
           users.character_name,
           users.level
    FROM guild_applications ga
    LEFT JOIN users ON users.user_id = ga.user_id
    WHERE ga.guild_id=? AND ga.status=?
    ORDER BY ga.created_at ASC
    """, (
        guild_id,
        status,
    ))

    return cursor.fetchall()


# ==============================
# ✅ PROGRESS / SCORE
# ==============================

def add_guild_progress(guild_id, exp=0, resource=0, kills=0, contracts=0, user_id=None, reason=""):
    """
    Додає прогрес гільдії одночасно в monthly і total counters.
    Також оновлює contribution учасника, якщо передано user_id.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild_id)

    exp = int(exp or 0)
    resource = int(resource or 0)
    kills = int(kills or 0)
    contracts = int(contracts or 0)
    score = calculate_guild_score(exp, resource, kills, contracts)

    if exp == 0 and resource == 0 and kills == 0 and contracts == 0:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": "ℹ️ Немає прогресу для додавання."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guilds
    SET exp = exp + ?,
        resource = resource + ?,
        monthly_exp = monthly_exp + ?,
        monthly_resource = monthly_resource + ?,
        monthly_kills = monthly_kills + ?,
        monthly_contracts = monthly_contracts + ?,
        monthly_score = monthly_score + ?,
        total_exp = total_exp + ?,
        total_resource = total_resource + ?,
        total_kills = total_kills + ?,
        total_contracts = total_contracts + ?,
        total_score = total_score + ?,
        updated_at=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        exp,
        resource,
        exp,
        resource,
        kills,
        contracts,
        score,
        exp,
        resource,
        kills,
        contracts,
        score,
        now_iso(),
        guild_id,
    ))

    if user_id is not None:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_members
        SET contribution_exp = contribution_exp + ?,
            contribution_resource = contribution_resource + ?,
            contribution_kills = contribution_kills + ?,
            contribution_contracts = contribution_contracts + ?,
            contribution_score = contribution_score + ?,
            monthly_contribution_exp = monthly_contribution_exp + ?,
            monthly_contribution_resource = monthly_contribution_resource + ?,
            monthly_contribution_kills = monthly_contribution_kills + ?,
            monthly_contribution_contracts = monthly_contribution_contracts + ?,
            monthly_contribution_score = monthly_contribution_score + ?
        WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?
        """, (
            exp,
            resource,
            kills,
            contracts,
            score,
            exp,
            resource,
            kills,
            contracts,
            score,
            guild_id,
            user_id,
        ))

    conn.commit()

    if reason:
        add_guild_log(
            guild_id=guild_id,
            event_type="progress",
            text=reason,
        )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "exp": exp,
        "resource": resource,
        "kills": kills,
        "contracts": contracts,
        "score": score,
        "message": "✅ Прогрес гільдії оновлено."
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ RANKINGS
# ==============================

def get_guild_ranking(scope="monthly", limit=10):
    """
    Рейтинг гільдій.

    scope="monthly": поточний місячний рейтинг.
    scope="total": рейтинг за весь час.

    Сортування завжди від більшого до меншого.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    ensure_all_guild_monthly_seasons()

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 10

    limit = max(1, min(100, limit))

    if scope == "total":
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT *
        FROM guilds
        ORDER BY total_score DESC,
                 total_exp DESC,
                 level DESC,
                 created_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
        """, (
            limit,
        ))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT *
        FROM guilds
        ORDER BY monthly_score DESC,
                 monthly_exp DESC,
                 total_score DESC,
                 created_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
        """, (
            limit,
        ))

    return cursor.fetchall()


def get_guild_season_history(guild_id=None, season_key=None, limit=20):
    init_guild_system()

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 20

    limit = max(1, min(100, limit))

    query = "SELECT * FROM guild_season_history WHERE 1=1"
    params = []

    if guild_id is not None:
        query += " AND guild_id=?"
        params.append(guild_id)

    if season_key is not None:
        query += " AND season_key=?"
        params.append(season_key)

    query += " ORDER BY season_key DESC, monthly_score DESC LIMIT ?"
    params.append(limit)

    cursor.execute(query, params)
    return cursor.fetchall()

def get_guild_display_name(guild):
    if not guild:
        return "Без гільдії"

    icon = guild["icon"] or "🏰"
    tag = guild["tag"] or "???"
    name = guild["name"] or "Гільдія"

    return f"{icon} [{tag}] {name}"


def get_guild_role_label(role):
    if role == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return "👑 Голова"
    if role == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER:
        return "🛡 Заступник"
    return "👤 Учасник"


# ==============================
# ✅ GUILD LIST APPLICATIONS CORE V1
# ==============================

# 7.0.4
# Список гільдій, перегляд деталей, подача заявки, перегляд моїх заявок.


def get_public_guild_list(limit=50, offset=0):
    """
    Публічний список гільдій.
    Сортування від більшого до меншого за total_score, далі level, далі дата створення.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    ensure_all_guild_monthly_seasons()

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 50

    try:
        offset = int(offset)
    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    limit = max(1, min(100, limit))
    offset = max(0, offset)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT g.*,
           COUNT(gm.user_id) AS member_count
    FROM guilds g
    LEFT JOIN guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = g.id
    GROUP BY g.id
    ORDER BY g.total_score DESC,
             g.level DESC,
             g.created_at ASC
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    """, (
        limit,
        offset,
    ))

    return cursor.fetchall()


def get_user_guild_applications(user_id, status=None):
    """
    Повертає заявки користувача.
    Якщо status=None — усі заявки.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    if status is None:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT ga.*,
               g.name AS guild_name,
               g.tag AS guild_tag,
               g.icon AS guild_icon
        FROM guild_applications ga
        JOIN guilds g ON g.id = ga.guild_id
        WHERE ga.user_id=?
        ORDER BY ga.created_at DESC
        """, (
            user_id,
        ))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT ga.*,
               g.name AS guild_name,
               g.tag AS guild_tag,
               g.icon AS guild_icon
        FROM guild_applications ga
        JOIN guilds g ON g.id = ga.guild_id
        WHERE ga.user_id=? AND ga.status=?
        ORDER BY ga.created_at DESC
        """, (
            user_id,
            status,
        ))

    return cursor.fetchall()


def has_pending_guild_application(user_id, guild_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT 1
    FROM guild_applications
    WHERE user_id=? AND guild_id=? AND status=?
    """, (
        user_id,
        guild_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
    ))

    return cursor.fetchone() is not None


def cancel_guild_application(user_id, application_id):
    """
    Скасовує pending заявку користувача.
    Буде корисно для UI пізніше.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT *
    FROM guild_applications
    WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND status=?
    """, (
        application_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
    ))

    app = cursor.fetchone()

    if not app:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Активну заявку не знайдено."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guild_applications
    SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED,
        now_iso(),
        user_id,
        application_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    try:
        add_guild_log(
            guild_id=app["guild_id"],
            event_type="application_cancelled",
            text=f"Заявку user_id={user_id} скасовано."
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "✅ Заявку скасовано."
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ UNIQUE GUILD ICON CORE V1
# ==============================

# 7.0.4a
# Іконка гільдії має бути унікальною.
# Якщо в БД вже є дублікати, перша гільдія залишає іконку,
# інші дублікати отримують резервні унікальні іконки.

GUILD_RESERVED_UNIQUE_ICONS = [
    "🏰", "🛡️", "⚔️", "🔥", "🌙", "⭐", "🐺", "🐉", "🍀", "💎",
    "🦅", "🦁", "🐻", "🦊", "🦂", "🦉", "🗡️", "🔱", "🌲", "🌋",
    "❄️", "⚡", "🌟", "🌹", "🍒", "🌊", "☀️", "🌌", "🪓", "🧿",
]


def normalize_guild_icon(value):
    icon = (value or "").strip()
    return icon or "🏰"


def get_guild_by_icon(icon):
    init_guild_system_tables_only()
    icon = normalize_guild_icon(icon)

    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM guilds WHERE icon=?", (icon,))
    return cursor.fetchone()


def is_guild_icon_taken(icon, exclude_guild_id=None):
    init_guild_system_tables_only()
    icon = normalize_guild_icon(icon)

    if exclude_guild_id is None:
        cursor.execute("SELECT 1 FROM guilds WHERE icon=?", (icon,))
    else:
        cursor.execute("SELECT 1 FROM guilds WHERE icon=? AND id != ?", (icon, exclude_guild_id))

    return cursor.fetchone() is not None


def _get_used_guild_icons():
    cursor.execute("SELECT icon FROM guilds")
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    used = set()

    for row in rows:
        try:
            icon = row["icon"]
        except Exception:
            icon = row[0]
        if icon:
            used.add(icon)

    return used


def _pick_unique_guild_icon(used_icons, preferred=None):
    preferred = normalize_guild_icon(preferred)

    if preferred and preferred not in used_icons:
        return preferred

    for icon in GUILD_RESERVED_UNIQUE_ICONS:
        if icon not in used_icons:
            return icon

    # Very rare fallback if all reserved icons are used.
    # SQLite UNIQUE only needs unique text; UI validation for new guilds still asks for short emoji.
    counter = 1
    while True:
        candidate = f"🏰{counter}"
        if candidate not in used_icons:
            return candidate
        counter += 1


def make_existing_guild_icons_unique():
    """
    Виправляє вже існуючі дублікати icon у guilds.

    Правило:
    - найстаріша/перша гільдія з конкретною іконкою зберігає її;
    - наступні дублікати отримують резервну унікальну іконку.
    """

    init_guild_system_tables_only()

    cursor.execute("SELECT id, icon, name, tag FROM guilds ORDER BY id ASC")
    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    seen = set()
    used = set()
    changes = []

    for row in rows:
        try:
            guild_id = row["id"]
            icon = normalize_guild_icon(row["icon"])
            name = row["name"]
            tag = row["tag"]
        except Exception:
            guild_id = row[0]
            icon = normalize_guild_icon(row[1])
            name = row[2] if len(row) > 2 else "Гільдія"
            tag = row[3] if len(row) > 3 else "???"

        if icon not in seen and icon not in used:
            seen.add(icon)
            used.add(icon)
            continue

        new_icon = _pick_unique_guild_icon(used)
        used.add(new_icon)

        cursor.execute("UPDATE guilds SET icon=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?", (new_icon, now_iso(), guild_id))
        changes.append((guild_id, icon, new_icon, name, tag))

    conn.commit()

    for guild_id, old_icon, new_icon, name, tag in changes:
        try:
            add_guild_log(
                guild_id=guild_id,
                event_type="icon_auto_changed",
                text=f"Іконку гільдії [{tag}] {name} автоматично змінено з {old_icon} на {new_icon}, бо іконки гільдій мають бути унікальними."
            )
        except Exception:
            pass

    return changes


def ensure_unique_guild_icon_index():
    """
    Створює UNIQUE index для guilds.icon після очищення дублікатів.
    """

    init_guild_system_tables_only()
    make_existing_guild_icons_unique()

    cursor.execute("CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_guilds_icon_unique ON guilds(icon)")
    conn.commit()

    return True


# Override validation from 7.0.1 with icon uniqueness check.
def validate_guild_create_input(name, tag, icon="🏰"):
    name = (name or "").strip()
    tag = normalize_guild_tag(tag)
    icon = normalize_guild_icon(icon)

    if len(name) < 3:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Назва гільдії має містити мінімум 3 символи."
        }

    if len(name) > 32:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Назва гільдії має бути не довша за 32 символи."
        }

    if len(tag) < 2:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Абревіатура гільдії має містити мінімум 2 символи."
        }

    if len(tag) > 5:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Абревіатура гільдії має бути не довша за 5 символів."
        }

    existing = get_guild_by_name_or_tag(name)
    if existing:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гільдія з такою назвою або абревіатурою вже існує."
        }

    existing_tag = get_guild_by_name_or_tag(tag)
    if existing_tag:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гільдія з такою назвою або абревіатурою вже існує."
        }

    if is_guild_icon_taken(icon):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Така іконка вже використовується іншою гільдією. Обери іншу іконку."
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "name": name,
        "tag": tag,
        "icon": icon,
    }


# Ensure uniqueness whenever module is loaded after the patch.
try:
    ensure_unique_guild_icon_index()
except Exception as _guild_icon_unique_error:
    print(f"⚠️ Failed to ensure unique guild icon index: {_guild_icon_unique_error}")

# ==============================

# 7.0.5
# Обробка заявок у гільдію: прийняти / відхилити.


def get_guild_application_by_id(application_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM guild_applications WHERE id=?", (application_id,))
    return cursor.fetchone()


def accept_guild_application(actor_user_id, application_id):
    """
    Приймає заявку до гільдії.
    Доступно тільки leader/officer цієї гільдії.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)

    if not app:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Заявку не знайдено."}

    if app["status"] != GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Ця заявка вже не очікує розгляду."}

    guild_id = app["guild_id"]
    applicant_user_id = app["user_id"]

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(actor_user_id, guild_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ У тебе немає прав для обробки заявок."}

    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)
    if not guild:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Гільдію не знайдено."}

    if is_user_in_guild(applicant_user_id):
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE id=?
        """, (
            GUILD_APPLICATION_REJECTED,
            now_iso(),
            actor_user_id,
            application_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Гравець уже перебуває в іншій гільдії. Заявку відхилено."}

    member_count = get_guild_member_count(guild_id)
    member_limit = int(guild["member_limit"] or DEFAULT_GUILD_MEMBER_LIMIT)

    if member_count >= member_limit:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ У гільдії немає вільних місць."}

    now = now_iso()

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO guild_members (guild_id, user_id, role, joined_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        applicant_user_id,
        GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER,
        now,
    ))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guild_applications
    SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED,
        now,
        actor_user_id,
        application_id,
    ))

    # Інші pending-заявки цього гравця автоматично скасовуємо.
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guild_applications
    SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
    WHERE user_id=? AND status=? AND id != ?
    """, (
        GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED,
        now,
        actor_user_id,
        applicant_user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
        application_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    applicant_name = f"user_id={applicant_user_id}"
    try:
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (applicant_user_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row:
            try:
                applicant_name = row["character_name"] or applicant_name
            except Exception:
                applicant_name = row[0] or applicant_name
    except Exception:
        pass

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="application_accepted",
        text=f"{applicant_name} вступив до гільдії."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"✅ {applicant_name} прийнято до гільдії."}


def reject_guild_application(actor_user_id, application_id):
    """
    Відхиляє заявку до гільдії.
    Доступно тільки leader/officer цієї гільдії.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    if app["status"] != GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING:

    guild_id = app["guild_id"]
    applicant_user_id = app["user_id"]

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(actor_user_id, guild_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ У тебе немає прав для обробки заявок."}

    now = now_iso()

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE guild_applications
    SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        GUILD_APPLICATION_REJECTED,
        now,
        actor_user_id,
        application_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    applicant_name = f"user_id={applicant_user_id}"
    try:
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (applicant_user_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row:
            try:
                applicant_name = row["character_name"] or applicant_name

    except Exception:
        pass

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,

    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"✅ Заявку від {applicant_name} відхилено."}


# ==============================
# ✅ GUILD MEMBERS ROLES CORE V1
# ==============================

# 7.0.6
# Керування учасниками гільдії:
# - призначити заступника
# - зняти заступника
# - виключити учасника


def get_guild_member(guild_id, user_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (guild_id, user_id)
    )
    return cursor.fetchone()


def get_character_name_by_user_id(user_id):
    try:
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            return f"user_id={user_id}"
        try:
            return row["character_name"] or f"user_id={user_id}"
        except Exception:
            return row[0] or f"user_id={user_id}"
    except Exception:
        return f"user_id={user_id}"


def is_guild_leader(user_id, guild_id):
    member = get_guild_member(guild_id, user_id)
    return bool(member and member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER)


def is_guild_officer(user_id, guild_id):
    member = get_guild_member(guild_id, user_id)
    return bool(member and member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER)


def promote_guild_member_to_officer(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    Призначити заступника.
    Дозволено тільки голові гільдії.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Ти не перебуваєш у гільдії."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей гравець не перебуває у твоїй гільдії."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if actor_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Призначати заступників може тільки 👑 Голова гільдії."}

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Голова гільдії вже має найвищу роль."}

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "ℹ️ Цей гравець уже є 🛡 Заступником."}

    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE guild_members SET role=? WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER, guild_id, target_user_id)
    )
    conn.commit()

    target_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(target_user_id)
    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="member_promoted",
        text=f"{target_name} призначений 🛡 Заступником."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"✅ {target_name} тепер 🛡 Заступник гільдії."}


def demote_guild_officer(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    Зняти заступника до учасника.
    Дозволено тільки голові гільдії.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Ти не перебуваєш у гільдії."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей гравець не перебуває у твоїй гільдії."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if actor_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Знімати заступників може тільки 👑 Голова гільдії."}

    if target_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей гравець не є заступником."}

    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE guild_members SET role=? WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER, guild_id, target_user_id)
    )
    conn.commit()

    target_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(target_user_id)
    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="member_demoted",
        text=f"{target_name} більше не є 🛡 Заступником."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"✅ {target_name} тепер 👤 Учасник гільдії."}


def kick_guild_member(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    Виключити учасника з гільдії.

    Правила:
    - Голова може виключати учасників і заступників, але не себе.
    - Заступник може виключати тільки звичайних учасників.
    - Учасник не може виключати нікого.
    - Голову не можна виключити.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Ти не перебуваєш у гільдії."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Цей гравець не перебуває у твоїй гільдії."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if int(actor_user_id) == int(target_user_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Не можна виключити самого себе."}

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Голову гільдії не можна виключити."}

    if actor_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Учасник не може виключати інших учасників."}

    if actor_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER and target_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Заступник може виключати тільки звичайних учасників."}

    cursor.execute(
        "DELETE FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (guild_id, target_user_id)
    )
    conn.commit()

    target_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(target_user_id)
    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="member_kicked",
        text=f"{target_name} виключений з гільдії."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"✅ {target_name} виключений з гільдії."}

def get_guild_officer_count(guild_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND role=?",
        (guild_id, GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER)
    )
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    try:
        return int(row["cnt"] or 0)
    except Exception:
        return int(row[0] or 0) if row else 0


def get_guild_officer_member(guild_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND role=? LIMIT 1",
        (guild_id, GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER)
    )
    return cursor.fetchone()
