# ==============================
# ✅ GUILD ACCEPT APPLICATION IDEMPOTENT FIX V1
# ==============================

# 7.0.6b
# Fix проблеми:
# - гравець уже додався в guild_members;
# - заявка лишилась pending;
# - повторне натискання ✅ Прийняти заявку падало через UNIQUE constraint
#   guild_applications(guild_id, user_id, status).
#
# Рішення:
# - прийняття заявки стало idempotent;
# - якщо гравець уже в цій гільдії, pending-заявка просто позначається accepted/removes duplicate safely;
# - якщо already є accepted-заявка з таким UNIQUE ключем, pending-заявка видаляється;
# - старі pending-заявки гравця в інші гільдії скасовуються.


def _guild_safe_set_application_status(application_id, status, processed_by=None):
    """
    Безпечно змінює статус заявки з урахуванням UNIQUE(guild_id, user_id, status).

    Якщо запис із таким status уже існує, поточна заявка видаляється,
    щоб не ламати БД і не залишати pending-дублікат.
    """

    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)
    if not app:
        return False

    now = now_iso()

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE id=?
        """, (
            status,
            now,
            processed_by,
            application_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()
        return True
    except Exception as error:
        if "UNIQUE constraint failed" not in str(error):
            raise

        # Є інша заявка з таким самим guild_id/user_id/status.
        # Поточний pending-запис більше не потрібен.
        cursor.execute("DELETE FROM guild_applications WHERE id=?", (application_id,))
        conn.commit()
        return True


def _guild_cancel_other_pending_applications(user_id, except_application_id=None, processed_by=None):
    now = now_iso()

    if except_application_id is None:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED,
            now,
            processed_by,
            user_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
        ))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND status=? AND id != ?
        """, (
            GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED,
            now,
            processed_by,
            user_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
            except_application_id,
        ))

    conn.commit()


# FINAL OVERRIDE for 7.0.5 accept_guild_application.
def accept_guild_application(actor_user_id, application_id):
    init_guild_system()

    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)

    if not app:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Заявку не знайдено."}

    guild_id = app["guild_id"]
    applicant_user_id = app["user_id"]

    if app["status"] != GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Ця заявка вже не очікує розгляду."}

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(actor_user_id, guild_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ У тебе немає прав для обробки заявок."}

    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)
    if not guild:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Гільдію не знайдено."}

    applicant_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(applicant_user_id)
    existing_member = get_user_guild_member(applicant_user_id)

    # Idempotent recovery: гравець уже в цій гільдії, але pending-заявка висить.
    if existing_member and int(existing_member["guild_id"]) == int(guild_id):
        _guild_safe_set_application_status(
            application_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED,
            processed_by=actor_user_id,
        )
        _guild_cancel_other_pending_applications(
            applicant_user_id,
            except_application_id=application_id,
            processed_by=actor_user_id,
        )
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"✅ {applicant_name} уже перебуває в цій гільдії. Заявку очищено."
        }

    # Якщо гравець уже в іншій гільдії — pending-заявку треба прибрати без падіння.
    if existing_member and int(existing_member["guild_id"]) != int(guild_id):
        _guild_safe_set_application_status(
            application_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_REJECTED,
            processed_by=actor_user_id,
        )
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Гравець уже перебуває в іншій гільдії. Заявку відхилено."}

    member_count = get_guild_member_count(guild_id)
    member_limit = int(guild["member_limit"] or DEFAULT_GUILD_MEMBER_LIMIT)

    if member_count >= member_limit:
        return {"success": False, "message": "❌ У гільдії немає вільних місць."}

    now = now_iso()

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO guild_members (guild_id, user_id, role, joined_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            guild_id,
            applicant_user_id,
            GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER,
            now,
        ))
        conn.commit()
    except Exception as error:
        # Якщо паралельно/раніше гравець уже був доданий — переводимо в idempotent branch.
        if "UNIQUE constraint failed" not in str(error):
            raise

    _guild_safe_set_application_status(
        application_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED,
        processed_by=actor_user_id,
    )

    _guild_cancel_other_pending_applications(
        applicant_user_id,
        except_application_id=application_id,
        processed_by=actor_user_id,
    )

    try:
        add_guild_log(
            guild_id=guild_id,
            event_type="application_accepted",
            text=f"{applicant_name} вступив до гільдії."
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {"success": True, "message": f"✅ {applicant_name} прийнято до гільдії."}


def cleanup_stale_guild_applications():
    """
    Чистить старі pending-заявки від гравців, які вже є в тій самій гільдії.
    Також прибирає pending-заявки в інші гільдії для гравців, які вже десь перебувають.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    fixed_same_guild = 0
    cancelled_other_guild = 0

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT ga.id, ga.guild_id, ga.user_id, gm.guild_id AS member_guild_id
    FROM guild_applications ga
    JOIN guild_members gm ON gm.user_id = ga.user_id
    WHERE ga.status=?
    """, (GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for row in rows:
        app_id = row["id"]
        app_guild_id = row["guild_id"]
        member_guild_id = row["member_guild_id"]

        if int(app_guild_id) == int(member_guild_id):
            _guild_safe_set_application_status(app_id, GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED, processed_by=None)
            fixed_same_guild += 1
        else:
            _guild_safe_set_application_status(app_id, GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED, processed_by=None)
            cancelled_other_guild += 1

    return {
        "fixed_same_guild": fixed_same_guild,
        "cancelled_other_guild": cancelled_other_guild,
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ GUILD PROGRESS CONTRIBUTIONS CORE V1
# ==============================

# 7.0.7
# Guild EXP / Resource / внесок учасників.
# На цьому етапі додаємо:
# - рівень гільдії від загального EXP;
# - рейтинг внеску учасників;
# - helper-и для прогресу;
# - add_guild_progress() лишається центральною точкою нарахування.

GUILD_LEVEL_EXP_BASE = 1000


def get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level):
    """
    Скільки total EXP потрібно для конкретного рівня гільдії.

    Level 1: 0
    Level 2: 1000
    Level 3: 3000
    Level 4: 6000

    Формула накопичувальна: sum(base * n) для n=1..level-1.
    """

    try:
        level = int(level)
    except Exception:
        level = 1

    level = max(1, level)

    if level <= 1:
        return 0

    return int(GUILD_LEVEL_EXP_BASE * ((level - 1) * level / 2))


def calculate_guild_level_from_exp(total_exp):
    try:
        total_exp = int(total_exp or 0)
    except Exception:
        total_exp = 0

    level = 1

    while total_exp >= get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level + 1):
        level += 1

    return level


def get_guild_next_level_info(guild_id):
    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)

    if not guild:
        return None

    total_exp = int(guild["total_exp"] or 0)
    level = int(guild["level"] or 1)
    calculated_level = calculate_guild_level_from_exp(total_exp)

    if calculated_level > level:
        level = calculated_level

    current_level_exp = get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level)
    next_level_exp = get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level + 1)
    progress_exp = max(0, total_exp - current_level_exp)
    needed_exp = max(1, next_level_exp - current_level_exp)
    progress_percent = min(100.0, max(0.0, progress_exp / needed_exp * 100))

    return {
        "level": level,
        "total_exp": total_exp,
        "current_level_exp": current_level_exp,
        "next_level_exp": next_level_exp,
        "progress_exp": progress_exp,
        "needed_exp": needed_exp,
        "progress_percent": progress_percent,
    }


def recalculate_guild_level(guild_id):
    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)

    if not guild:
        return None

    old_level = int(guild["level"] or 1)
    total_exp = int(guild["total_exp"] or 0)
    new_level = calculate_guild_level_from_exp(total_exp)

    if new_level != old_level:
        cursor.execute(
            "UPDATE guilds SET level=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
            (new_level, now_iso(), guild_id)
        )
        conn.commit()

        if new_level > old_level:
            try:
                add_guild_log(
                    guild_id=guild_id,
                    event_type="guild_level_up",
                    text=f"Гільдія піднялась до рівня {new_level}."
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

    return new_level


try:
    _base_add_guild_progress_before_contributions_v1 = add_guild_progress
except Exception:
    _base_add_guild_progress_before_contributions_v1 = None


def add_guild_progress(guild_id, exp=0, resource=0, kills=0, contracts=0, user_id=None, reason=""):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    Додає прогрес через базову функцію 7.0.1 і після цього перераховує рівень гільдії.
    """

    if _base_add_guild_progress_before_contributions_v1 is None:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Базова функція add_guild_progress недоступна."
        }

    result = _base_add_guild_progress_before_contributions_v1(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        exp=exp,
        resource=resource,
        kills=kills,
        contracts=contracts,
        user_id=user_id,
        reason=reason,
    )

    try:
        result["guild_level"] = recalculate_guild_level(guild_id)
        result["next_level_info"] = get_guild_next_level_info(guild_id)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return result


def add_user_guild_progress(user_id, exp=0, resource=0, kills=0, contracts=0, reason=""):
    """
    Додає прогрес гільдії від конкретного учасника.
    Саме цю функцію варто використовувати для майбутньої інтеграції з контрактами/елітними мобами.
    """

    member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)

    if not member:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гравець не перебуває у гільдії."
        }

    return add_guild_progress(
        guild_id=member["guild_id"],
        exp=exp,
        resource=resource,
        kills=kills,
        contracts=contracts,
        user_id=user_id,
        reason=reason,
    )


def get_guild_contribution_ranking(guild_id, scope="monthly", limit=30):
    init_guild_system()
    ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild_id)

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 30

    limit = max(1, min(100, limit))

    if scope == "total":
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT gm.*,
               users.character_name,
               users.level
        FROM guild_members gm
        LEFT JOIN users ON users.user_id = gm.user_id
        WHERE gm.guild_id=?
        ORDER BY gm.contribution_score DESC,
                 gm.contribution_exp DESC,
                 gm.joined_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
        """, (guild_id, limit))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT gm.*,
               users.character_name,
               users.level
        FROM guild_members gm
        LEFT JOIN users ON users.user_id = gm.user_id
        WHERE gm.guild_id=?
        ORDER BY gm.monthly_contribution_score DESC,
                 gm.monthly_contribution_exp DESC,
                 gm.joined_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
        """, (guild_id, limit))

    return cursor.fetchall()


def cleanup_recalculate_all_guild_levels():
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM guilds")
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    updated = 0

    for row in rows:
        try:
            guild_id = row["id"]
        except Exception:
            guild_id = row[0]
        old = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)["level"]
        new = recalculate_guild_level(guild_id)
        if new != old:
            updated += 1

    return updated

except Exception:

def create_guild_application(user_id, guild_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    Подача заявки з журналом через character_name замість user_id.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    if is_user_in_guild(user_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Ти вже перебуваєш у гільдії."
        }

    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)

    if not guild:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Гільдію не знайдено."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT * FROM guild_applications
    WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=? AND status=?
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
    ))

    if cursor.fetchone():
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "ℹ️ Ти вже подав заявку в цю гільдію."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO guild_applications (guild_id, user_id, status, created_at)
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
        now_iso(),
    ))

    conn.commit()

    applicant_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(user_id)

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="application_created",
        text=f"Нова заявка до гільдії від {applicant_name}."
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "✅ Заявку до гільдії подано."
    }

# 7.0.9
# Guild EXP / Resource integration points:
# - elite mob victory reward
# - contract completion reward helper

GUILD_ELITE_KILL_EXP_REWARD = 25
GUILD_ELITE_KILL_RESOURCE_REWARD = 1
GUILD_ELITE_KILL_SCORE_REASON = "Перемога над елітним мобом"

GUILD_CONTRACT_EXP_REWARD = 50
GUILD_CONTRACT_RESOURCE_REWARD = 3
GUILD_CONTRACT_SCORE_REASON = "Виконання контракту"


def _guild_activity_result_text(result):
    if not result or not result.get("success"):
        return None

    exp = int(result.get("exp", 0) or 0)
    resource = int(result.get("resource", 0) or 0)
    kills = int(result.get("kills", 0) or 0)
    contracts = int(result.get("contracts", 0) or 0)

    parts = []
    if exp:
        parts.append(f"+{exp} EXP")
    if resource:
        parts.append(f"+{resource} ресурс")
    if kills:
        parts.append(f"+{kills} вбивство")
    if contracts:
        parts.append(f"+{contracts} контракт")

    if not parts:
        return None

    return "🏰 Гільдія: " + ", ".join(parts)


def _get_guild_event_actor_name(user_id):
    """Resolve a character name for Guild log enrichment.

    A lazy Character System import avoids introducing a module-import cycle.
    Empty, invalid, or unavailable names intentionally produce an empty string,
    so Guild events keep their previous text without exposing a technical ID.
    """
    try:
        from systems.character_system import get_character_name

        actor_name = get_character_name(user_id)
        if actor_name is None:
            return ""

        actor_name = str(actor_name).strip()
        return actor_name
    except Exception:
        return ""

def award_guild_elite_kill(user_id, mob=None):
    """
    Нарахування прогресу гільдії за перемогу над елітним мобом.

    Повертає dict add_user_guild_progress або success=False, якщо гравець без гільдії.
    """

    member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)

    if not member:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "Гравець не перебуває у гільдії."
        }

    mob_name = "елітним мобом"
    try:
        if mob:
            mob_name = mob.get("name") or mob.get("title") or mob_name
    except Exception:
        pass

    actor_name = str(_get_guild_event_actor_name(user_id) or "").strip()
    reason = f"{GUILD_ELITE_KILL_SCORE_REASON}: {mob_name}."
    if actor_name:
        reason += f" (переміг: {actor_name})"

    return add_user_guild_progress(
        user_id=user_id,
        exp=GUILD_ELITE_KILL_EXP_REWARD,
        resource=GUILD_ELITE_KILL_RESOURCE_REWARD,
        kills=1,
        contracts=0,
        reason=reason
    )



def award_guild_contract_completion(user_id, contract=None):
    """
    Нарахування прогресу гільдії за виконання контракту.

    Цю функцію можна викликати з системи контрактів після успішного завершення контракту.
    """

    member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)

    if not member:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "Гравець не перебуває у гільдії."
        }

    contract_name = "контракт"
    try:
        if isinstance(contract, dict):
            contract_name = (
                contract.get("target_mob_name")
                or contract.get("name")
                or contract.get("title")
                or contract.get("contract_name")
                or contract_name
            )
        elif contract:
            contract_name = str(contract)
    except Exception:
        pass

    actor_name = str(_get_guild_event_actor_name(user_id) or "").strip()
    reason = f"{GUILD_CONTRACT_SCORE_REASON}: {contract_name}."
    if actor_name:
        reason += f" (виконав: {actor_name})"

    return add_user_guild_progress(
        user_id=user_id,
        exp=GUILD_CONTRACT_EXP_REWARD,
        resource=GUILD_CONTRACT_RESOURCE_REWARD,
        kills=0,
        contracts=1,
        reason=reason
    )



def get_guild_activity_reward_text(result):
    return _guild_activity_result_text(result)

def get_guild_diagnostics(user_id):
    """
    Technical diagnostics for /guild_debug.
    Safe read-only helper.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    diagnostics = {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "season_key": get_current_guild_season_key(),
        "has_guild": False,
        "guild": None,
        "member": None,
        "member_count": 0,
        "pending_applications": 0,
        "user_pending_applications": 0,
        "officer_count": 0,
        "next_level_info": None,
    }

    try:
        member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)
        diagnostics["member"] = member
        diagnostics["user_pending_applications"] = get_user_pending_applications_count(user_id)

        if not member:
            return diagnostics

        guild = get_guild_by_id(member["guild_id"])
        diagnostics["guild"] = guild
        diagnostics["has_guild"] = bool(guild)

        if guild:
            ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild["id"])
            diagnostics["member_count"] = get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
            diagnostics["pending_applications"] = get_guild_pending_applications_count(guild["id"])

            try:
                diagnostics["officer_count"] = get_guild_officer_count(guild["id"])
            except Exception:
                diagnostics["officer_count"] = 0

            try:
                diagnostics["next_level_info"] = get_guild_next_level_info(guild["id"])
            except Exception:
                diagnostics["next_level_info"] = None

    except Exception as error:
        diagnostics["error"] = str(error)

    return diagnostics


def run_guild_sanity_cleanup():
    """
    Conservative cleanup used by /guild_fix_states and startup-compatible calls:
    - stale pending applications for players already in guilds;
    - guild levels recalculation;
    - duplicate icon/index checks if available.
    """

    result = {
        "stale_applications": None,
        "levels_recalculated": None,
        "icons_checked": False,
        "ok": True,
        "errors": [],
    }

    try:
        try:
            result["stale_applications"] = cleanup_stale_guild_applications()
        except Exception as error:
            result["errors"].append(f"cleanup_stale_guild_applications: {error}")

        try:
            result["levels_recalculated"] = cleanup_recalculate_all_guild_levels()
        except Exception as error:
            result["errors"].append(f"cleanup_recalculate_all_guild_levels: {error}")

        try:
            ensure_unique_guild_icon_index()
            result["icons_checked"] = True
        except Exception as error:
            result["errors"].append(f"ensure_unique_guild_icon_index: {error}")

    except Exception as error:
        result["ok"] = False
        result["errors"].append(str(error))

    if result["errors"]:
        result["ok"] = False

    return result

DB_PATH = "game.db"

NOTIFICATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60

# ==============================
# ✅ DB CONNECTION FOR WORKER

def create_worker_connection():
    """
    Окреме SQLite-підключення для notification worker.
    Не використовує глобальний conn/cursor з db.py.
    """

    conn = sqlite3.connect(
        DB_PATH,
        check_same_thread=False,
        timeout=30
    )

    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
    except Exception:
        pass

    return conn


# ==============================

# ==============================

def init_energy_columns(conn):
    migrations = [
        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET energy = ?
    WHERE energy IS NULL OR energy < 0
    """, (0,))

    # Видалено небезпечне обнулення - це спричиняло помилки при регенерації energ


def apply_energy_regen(conn, user_id):
    """
    Повертає актуальну Втому з урахуванням зниження (регенації).
    """

    init_energy_columns(conn)

    row = conn.execute("""
    SELECT energy, last_energy_update
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "energy": 0,
            "max_energy": ENERGY_MAX
        }

    energy, last_update = row

    if energy is None:
        energy = 0

    now = datetime.now()

    if not last_update:
        last_update_dt = now
    else:
        try:
            last_update_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_update)
        except Exception:
            last_update_dt = now

    if energy > 0:
        diff_seconds = (now - last_update_dt).total_seconds()
        regen_units = int(diff_seconds // (ENERGY_REGEN_MINUTES * 60))

        if regen_units > 0:
            energy = max(0, energy - regen_units)
            last_update_dt = last_update_dt + timedelta(
                minutes=regen_units * ENERGY_REGEN_MINUTES
            )

            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET energy=?,
                last_energy_update=?
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (
                energy,
                last_update_dt.isoformat(),
                user_id
            ))

            conn.commit()

    # Коли energy == 0, не потрібно оновлювати таймер (він вже на 0)

    return {
        "energy": energy,
        "max_energy": ENERGY_MAX
    }


def get_users_for_energy_full_notification_worker(conn):
    """
    Повертає user_id гравців, у яких Втома стала 0 (повністю відновлено),
    але повідомлення ще не надсилалося.
    """

    init_energy_columns(conn)

    rows = conn.execute("""
    SELECT user_id
    FROM users
    """).fetchall()

    notify_users = []

    for row in rows:
        user_id = row[0]

        energy_data = apply_energy_regen(conn, user_id)
        energy = energy_data["energy"]
        max_energy = energy_data["max_energy"]

        notified_row = conn.execute("""
        SELECT energy_full_notified
        FROM users
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

        notified = notified_row[0] if notified_row else 0

        if energy <= 0 and not notified:
            notify_users.append(user_id)

            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET energy_full_notified=1
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (user_id,))

        elif energy > 0 and notified:
            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET energy_full_notified=0
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()

    return notify_users

def init_hp_columns(conn):
    migrations = [
        ("users", "last_hp_regen_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "hp_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()


def get_equipped_stat_bonus(conn, user_id, stat_column):
    """
    Повертає сумарний бонус екіпірування для конкретної характеристики.
    Враховує тільки вдягнені предмети з durability > 0.
    """

    try:
        rows = conn.execute(f"""
        SELECT items.{stat_column}, inventory.durability
        FROM equipment_slots
        JOIN inventory ON equipment_slots.inventory_id = inventory.id
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE equipment_slots.user_id=?
          AND equipment_slots.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
        """, (user_id,)).fetchall()
    except Exception:
        return 0

    total = 0

    for bonus, durability in rows:
        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:
            continue

        total += bonus or 0

    return total


def get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id):
    """
    Повторює логіку get_max_hp з db.py:
    max_hp = 100 + level * 20 + total_sta * 5
    """

    row = conn.execute("""
    SELECT level, sta
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return 100

    level, base_sta = row

    level = level or 1
    base_sta = base_sta or 10

    item_sta = get_equipped_stat_bonus(conn, user_id, "bonus_sta")

    total_sta = base_sta + item_sta

    return 100 + (level * 20) + (total_sta * 5)


def apply_hp_regen(conn, user_id):
    """
    Повертає актуальне HP з урахуванням пасивної регенерації.
    """

    init_hp_columns(conn)

    row = conn.execute("""
    SELECT hp, last_hp_regen_update
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "hp": 0,
            "max_hp": 100
        }

    hp, last_update = row
    max_hp = get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id)

    if hp is None:
        hp = max_hp

    now = datetime.now()

    if not last_update:
        last_update_dt = now

        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET last_hp_regen_update=?
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            last_update_dt.isoformat(),
            user_id
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp
        }

    try:
        last_update_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_update)
    except Exception:
        last_update_dt = now

    if hp >= max_hp:
        hp = max_hp

        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET hp=?,
            last_hp_regen_update=?,
            hp_full_notified=1
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            max_hp,
            now.isoformat(),
            user_id
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": max_hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp
        }

    diff_seconds = (now - last_update_dt).total_seconds()
    regen_ticks = int(diff_seconds // (HP_REGEN_MINUTES * 60))

    if regen_ticks <= 0:
        return {
            "hp": hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp
        }

    heal_per_tick = max(1, int(max_hp * HP_REGEN_PERCENT))
    total_heal = heal_per_tick * regen_ticks

    new_hp = min(max_hp, hp + total_heal)

    new_update_dt = last_update_dt + timedelta(
        minutes=regen_ticks * HP_REGEN_MINUTES
    )

    hp_full_notified = 0 if new_hp >= max_hp else 0

    conn.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET hp=?,
        last_hp_regen_update=?,
        hp_full_notified=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_hp,
        new_update_dt.isoformat(),
        hp_full_notified,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": max_hp
    }


def get_users_for_hp_full_notification_worker(conn):
    """
    Повертає user_id гравців, у яких HP стало повним,
    але повідомлення ще не надсилалося.

    return notify_users

def notification_worker(bot_instance):
    conn = create_worker_connection()

    print("✅ NOTIFICATION WORKER DB CONNECTION READY")

    while True:
        try:
            notify_energy_full(bot_instance, conn)
            notify_hp_restored(bot_instance, conn)

            # Майбутні повідомлення:
            # notify_daily_contracts_reset(bot_instance, conn)
            # notify_craft_or_repair_ready(bot_instance, conn)

        except Exception as error:
            print(f"⚠️ NOTIFICATION WORKER ERROR: {error}")

            try:
                conn.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

            try:
                conn = create_worker_connection()
                print("✅ NOTIFICATION WORKER DB CONNECTION RECREATED")
            except Exception as reconnect_error:
                print(f"❌ NOTIFICATION WORKER DB RECONNECT ERROR: {reconnect_error}")

        time.sleep(NOTIFICATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS)


def start_notification_worker(bot_instance):
    thread = threading.Thread(
        target=notification_worker,
        args=(bot_instance,),
        daemon=True
    )

    thread.start()

    print("✅ NOTIFICATION WORKER STARTED")


# ==============================
# ✅ ROM 9.0.2d NOTIFICATION HP DYNAMIC MAX FIX V1
# ==============================

# Fix reason:
# Notification worker had its own get_worker_max_hp() formula and did not include
# refine armor HP bonus. Because of that it could treat 365/365 as full HP while
# the real dynamic max HP from +6 armor was 380.
#
# This override keeps notifications worker self-contained and uses the worker DB
# connection instead of importing db.py in the worker thread.

try:
    _notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = get_worker_max_hp
except NameError:
    _notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = None

try:
    _notifications_base_apply_hp_regen_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = apply_hp_regen
except NameError:
    _notifications_base_apply_hp_regen_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = None


WORKER_ARMOR_HP_BONUS_PER_REFINE_LEVEL_V1 = 4.0 / 6.0
WORKER_ARMOR_SLOTS_FOR_HP_REFINE_V1 = {
    "helmet",
    "shoulders",
    "chest",
    "gloves",
    "legs",
    "boots",
}


def _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, table_name):
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name})").fetchall()
        return {row[1] for row in rows}
    except Exception:
        return set()


def _worker_iso_to_dt_v1(value):
    if not value:
        return None

    text = str(value).strip()

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", ""))
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("T", " ").split(".")[0])
    except Exception:
        return None


def get_worker_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_v1(conn, user_id):
    """
    Calculates HP bonus from currently equipped refined armor for notification worker.

    Current known rule from refine 6.0:
    - armor +6 gives +4% max HP;
    - therefore 1 refine level ~= 0.6667% max HP.

    This mirrors the gameplay intent well enough for notification/full-HP checks.
    """

    try:
        equipment_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "equipment_slots")
        inventory_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "inventory")
        item_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "items")

        if not {"user_id", "slot_key", "inventory_id"}.issubset(equipment_cols):
            return 0.0

        if "refine_level" not in inventory_cols:
            return 0.0

        if "slot_key" not in item_cols:
            return 0.0

        rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT
            es.slot_key AS equipped_slot,
            COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0) AS refine_level,
            items.slot_key AS item_slot,
            items.category AS category
        FROM equipment_slots es
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id = es.inventory_id
        JOIN items ON items.id = inv.item_id
        WHERE es.user_id=?
          AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
        """, (user_id,)).fetchall()

        total_percent = 0.0

        for row in rows:
            equipped_slot = row[0]
            refine_level = int(row[1] or 0)
            item_slot = row[2]

            slot = equipped_slot or item_slot

            if refine_level <= 0:
                continue

            if slot not in WORKER_ARMOR_SLOTS_FOR_HP_REFINE_V1:
                continue

            total_percent += refine_level * WORKER_ARMOR_HP_BONUS_PER_REFINE_LEVEL_V1

        return max(0.0, total_percent)

    except Exception:
        return 0.0


def get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id):
    """
    Dynamic max HP for notification worker.

    Uses the existing worker base formula, then applies refine armor HP bonus.
    Also syncs users.max_hp so DB snapshots match profile logic.
    """

    if _notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1:
        try:
            base_hp = int(_notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1(conn, user_id) or 1)
        except Exception:
            base_hp = 100
    else:
        base_hp = 100

    bonus_percent = get_worker_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_v1(conn, user_id)
    dynamic_max_hp = int(round(base_hp * (1 + bonus_percent / 100.0)))
    dynamic_max_hp = max(1, dynamic_max_hp)

    try:
        user_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "users")
        if "max_hp" in user_cols:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE users SET max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                (dynamic_max_hp, user_id),
            )
            conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return dynamic_max_hp


def apply_hp_regen(conn, user_id):
    """
    HP regen that respects dynamic max HP from refined armor.

    Important behavior:
    - equipping refined armor increases max HP but does not heal instantly;
    - passive regen heals toward the dynamic max;
    - full HP notification only fires at dynamic max, not stale stored max_hp.
    """

    init_hp_columns(conn)

    user_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "users")
    has_max_hp = "max_hp" in user_cols

    select_cols = ["hp", "last_hp_regen_update"]
    if has_max_hp:
        select_cols.insert(1, "max_hp")

    row = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT {', '.join(select_cols)} FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (user_id,)
    ).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "hp": 0,
            "max_hp": 100,
        }

    if has_max_hp:
        hp = row[0]
        stored_max_hp = row[1]
        last_update = row[2]
    else:
        hp = row[0]
        stored_max_hp = None
        last_update = row[1]

    max_hp = get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id)

    if hp is None:
        hp = max_hp

    hp = int(hp or 0)

    now = datetime.now()

    last_update_dt = _worker_iso_to_dt_v1(last_update)

    if last_update_dt is None:
        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET last_hp_regen_update=?
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            now.isoformat(),
            user_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": min(hp, max_hp),
            "max_hp": max_hp,
        }

    # Clamp overheal / stale HP down to dynamic max.
    if hp >= max_hp:
        hp = max_hp

        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET hp=?,
            last_hp_regen_update=?,
            hp_full_notified=1
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            max_hp,
            now.isoformat(),
            user_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": max_hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp,
        }

    diff_seconds = (now - last_update_dt).total_seconds()

    if diff_seconds < 0:
        diff_seconds = 0

    regen_ticks = int(diff_seconds // (HP_REGEN_MINUTES * 60))

    if regen_ticks <= 0:
        # Below dynamic max but not enough time has passed. Do not mark full.
        if has_max_hp and stored_max_hp != max_hp:
            try:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET max_hp=?, hp_full_notified=0 WHERE user_id=?",
                    (max_hp, user_id),
                )
                conn.commit()
            except Exception:
                pass

        return {
            "hp": hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp,
        }

    heal_per_tick = max(1, int(max_hp * HP_REGEN_PERCENT))
    total_heal = heal_per_tick * regen_ticks
    new_hp = min(max_hp, hp + total_heal)

    new_update_dt = last_update_dt + timedelta(
        minutes=regen_ticks * HP_REGEN_MINUTES
    )

    # If HP became full, keep hp_full_notified=0 so get_users_for_hp_full_notification_worker()
    # can send one notification and then mark it as notified.
    hp_full_notified = 0

    conn.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET hp=?,
        max_hp=?,
        last_hp_regen_update=?,
        hp_full_notified=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_hp,
        max_hp,
        new_update_dt.isoformat(),
        hp_full_notified,
        user_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": max_hp,
    }

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Presence and persistent activity session foundation for Stage 12.1.0."""
from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sqlite3
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Iterable

LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)
DEFAULT_DB_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "game.db"
PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 300
PLAYER_PRESENCE_WRITE_THROTTLE_SECONDS = 30
PLAYER_ACTIVITY_TYPES = frozenset(("trade_request", "trade", "duel_request", "pvp_battle"))

_PRESENCE_LOCK = threading.RLock()
_LAST_WRITE: dict[int, float] = {}
_INSTALL_LOCK = threading.RLock()


def _connect(db_path=None):
    path = Path(db_path) if db_path is not None else DEFAULT_DB_PATH
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path), timeout=30.0)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
    return conn


def _now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def _text(value=None):
    value = value or _now()
    if value.tzinfo is None:
        value = value.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _parse(value):
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(value).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def init_player_interaction_foundation(db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        columns = {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)")}
        if not columns:
            raise RuntimeError("users table is missing; init_db() must run first")
        added = False
        if "last_activity_at" not in columns:
            conn.execute("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN last_activity_at TEXT NULL")
            added = True
        conn.executescript("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_activity_sessions (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                user_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                activity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
                    activity_type IN ('trade_request','trade','duel_request','pvp_battle')
                ),
                reference_id INTEGER NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
                created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires_at TEXT NULL,
                FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
            );
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_last_activity_at
                ON users(last_activity_at);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_activity_sessions_expires_at
                ON player_activity_sessions(expires_at);
            CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_activity_sessions_type_status
                ON player_activity_sessions(activity_type, status);
        """)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    removed = expire_stale_player_activity_sessions(db_path=db_path)
    return {
        "success": True,
        "presence_column_added": added,
        "expired_sessions_removed": removed,
        "online_timeout_seconds": PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        "write_throttle_seconds": PLAYER_PRESENCE_WRITE_THROTTLE_SECONDS,
    }


def touch_player_activity(user_id, *, force=False, now=None, db_path=None):
    uid = int(user_id)
    mono = time.monotonic()
    if not force:
        with _PRESENCE_LOCK:
            previous = _LAST_WRITE.get(uid)
            if previous is not None and mono - previous < PLAYER_PRESENCE_WRITE_THROTTLE_SECONDS:
                return {"success": True, "updated": False, "reason": "throttled"}
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        stamp = _text(now)
        cur = conn.execute("UPDATE users SET last_activity_at=? WHERE user_id=?", (stamp, uid))
        conn.commit()
        if cur.rowcount != 1:
            return {"success": False, "updated": False, "reason": "user_not_found"}
    finally:
        conn.close()
    with _PRESENCE_LOCK:
        _LAST_WRITE[uid] = mono
    return {"success": True, "updated": True, "last_activity_at": stamp}


def get_player_last_activity(user_id, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT last_activity_at FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),)).fetchone()
        return _parse(row[0]) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def is_player_online(user_id, *, now=None, timeout_seconds=PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, db_path=None):
    last = get_player_last_activity(user_id, db_path=db_path)
    if last is None:
        return False
    current = now or _now()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    age = (current.astimezone(timezone.utc) - last).total_seconds()
    return 0 <= age <= max(0, int(timeout_seconds))


def expire_stale_player_activity_sessions(*, now=None, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= ?",
            (_text(now),),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return max(0, int(cur.rowcount))
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_player_activity_session(user_id, *, include_expired=False, now=None, db_path=None):
    if not include_expired:
        expire_stale_player_activity_sessions(now=now, db_path=db_path)
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id,user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at "
            "FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE user_id=?",
            (int(user_id),),
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def acquire_player_activity_session(user_id, activity_type, *, reference_id=None,
                                    status="active", ttl_seconds=None, now=None, db_path=None):
    uid = int(user_id)
    kind = str(activity_type)
    if kind not in PLAYER_ACTIVITY_TYPES:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "invalid_activity_type"}
    current = now or _now()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    stamp = _text(current)
    expires = _text(current + timedelta(seconds=int(ttl_seconds))) if ttl_seconds is not None else None
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
            "WHERE user_id=? AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= ?",
            (uid, stamp),
        )
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id,activity_type,reference_id,status,expires_at "
            "FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE user_id=?", (uid,)
        ).fetchone()
        if row:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "player_busy", "session": dict(row)}
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions "
            "(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (uid, kind, reference_id, str(status), stamp, stamp, expires),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return {"success": True, "session_id": int(cur.lastrowid), "expires_at": expires}
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        return {"success": False, "reason": "integrity_error", "error": str(exc)}
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def refresh_player_activity_session(user_id, *, expected_activity_type=None,
                                    status=None, ttl_seconds=None, now=None, db_path=None):
    current = now or _now()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    clauses = ["updated_at=?"]
    params: list[Any] = [_text(current)]
    expires = None
    if status is not None:
        clauses.append("status=?")
        params.append(str(status))
    if ttl_seconds is not None:
        expires = _text(current + timedelta(seconds=int(ttl_seconds)))
        clauses.append("expires_at=?")
        params.append(expires)
    query = "UPDATE player_activity_sessions SET " + ",".join(clauses) + " WHERE user_id=?"
    params.append(int(user_id))
    if expected_activity_type is not None:
        query += " AND activity_type=?"
        params.append(str(expected_activity_type))
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(query, tuple(params))
        conn.commit()
        return {"success": cur.rowcount == 1, "updated": cur.rowcount == 1, "expires_at": expires}
    finally:
        conn.close()


def release_player_activity_session(user_id, *, activity_type=None, reference_id=None, db_path=None):
    query = "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE user_id=?"
    params: list[Any] = [int(user_id)]
    if activity_type is not None:
        query += " AND activity_type=?"
        params.append(str(activity_type))
    if reference_id is not None:
        query += " AND reference_id=?"
        params.append(int(reference_id))
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(query, tuple(params))
        conn.commit()
        return {"success": True, "released": max(0, int(cur.rowcount))}
    finally:
        conn.close()


def is_player_interaction_busy(user_id, db_path=None):
    return get_player_activity_session(user_id, db_path=db_path) is not None


def _extract_update_user_ids(updates: Iterable[Any]):
    result = set()
    for update in updates or ():
        for name in ("message", "edited_message", "channel_post", "edited_channel_post",
                     "callback_query", "inline_query", "chosen_inline_result",
                     "shipping_query", "pre_checkout_query"):
            obj = getattr(update, name, None)
            if obj is None:
                continue
            actor = getattr(obj, "from_user", None)
            uid = getattr(actor, "id", None) if actor is not None else None
            if uid is not None:
                try:
                    result.add(int(uid))
                except (TypeError, ValueError):
                    pass
    return result


def install_player_presence_tracking(bot, db_path=None):
    """Touch presence before TeleBot dispatch; never block polling on DB errors."""
    with _INSTALL_LOCK:
        if getattr(bot, "_rom_presence_tracker_12_1_0", False):
            return {"success": True, "installed": False, "reason": "already_installed"}
        original = getattr(bot, "process_new_updates", None)
        if not callable(original):
            raise RuntimeError("bot.process_new_updates is unavailable")

        def wrapped(updates):
            for uid in _extract_update_user_ids(updates):
                try:
                    touch_player_activity(uid, db_path=db_path)
                except Exception as exc:
                    LOGGER.warning("Presence update failed for user %s: %s", uid, exc)
            return original(updates)

        bot.process_new_updates = wrapped
        bot._rom_presence_tracker_12_1_0 = True
        bot._rom_presence_original_process_new_updates = original
        return {"success": True, "installed": True}

# ROM 12.2.0 MAP LOCATION PLAYER DISCOVERY
PLAYER_DISCOVERY_PAGE_SIZE = 8


def _users_column_names(conn):
    return {row[1] for row in conn.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)").fetchall()}


def _pick_user_column(columns, candidates):
    for candidate in candidates:
        if candidate in columns:
            return candidate
    return None


def get_online_players_in_same_location(user_id, *, page=0,
                                        page_size=PLAYER_DISCOVERY_PAGE_SIZE,
                                        now=None, db_path=None):
    """Return online registered characters from the viewer's current location.

    The viewer is never included. Results are deterministically sorted and paged.
    """
    uid = int(user_id)
    page = max(0, int(page))
    page_size = max(1, min(20, int(page_size)))
    current = now or _now()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    cutoff = _text(current - timedelta(seconds=PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        columns = _users_column_names(conn)
        location_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("current_location", "location"))
        name_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("character_name", "name", "username"))
        level_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("level", "player_level"))
        class_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("character_class", "class_name", "class"))
        if location_col is None or name_col is None:
            raise RuntimeError("users location/name columns are unavailable")
        viewer = conn.execute(
            f'SELECT "{location_col}" AS location FROM users WHERE user_id=?',
            (uid,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not viewer or not viewer["location"]:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "viewer_location_missing", "players": []}
        select_level = f'"{level_col}"' if level_col else "NULL"
        select_class = f'"{class_col}"' if class_col else "NULL"
        rows = conn.execute(
            f'SELECT user_id, "{name_col}" AS character_name, '
            f'{select_level} AS level, {select_class} AS character_class, '
            f'"{location_col}" AS current_location, last_activity_at '
            f'FROM users WHERE user_id<>? AND "{location_col}"=? '
            f'AND last_activity_at IS NOT NULL AND last_activity_at>=? '
            f'AND TRIM(COALESCE("{name_col}", ""))<>"" '
            f'ORDER BY LOWER("{name_col}"), user_id',
            (uid, viewer["location"], cutoff),
        ).fetchall()
        players = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        total = len(players)
        start = page * page_size
        selected = players[start:start + page_size]
        return {
            "success": True,
            "location": viewer["location"],
            "players": selected,
            "page": page,
            "page_size": page_size,
            "total": total,
            "pages": max(1, (total + page_size - 1) // page_size),
            "has_previous": page > 0,
            "has_next": start + page_size < total,
        }
    finally:
        conn.close()


def get_public_player_interaction_profile(viewer_id, target_id, *, now=None, db_path=None):
    viewer_id = int(viewer_id)
    target_id = int(target_id)
    if viewer_id == target_id:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "self_target"}
    current = now or _now()
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        columns = _users_column_names(conn)
        location_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("current_location", "location"))
        name_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("character_name", "name", "username"))
        level_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("level", "player_level"))
        class_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("character_class", "class_name", "class"))
        if location_col is None or name_col is None:
            raise RuntimeError("users location/name columns are unavailable")
        level_expr = f'"{level_col}"' if level_col else "NULL"
        class_expr = f'"{class_col}"' if class_col else "NULL"
        viewer = conn.execute(
            f'SELECT "{location_col}" AS location FROM users WHERE user_id=?',
            (viewer_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        target = conn.execute(
            f'SELECT user_id, "{name_col}" AS character_name, {level_expr} AS level, '
            f'{class_expr} AS character_class, "{location_col}" AS current_location, '
            f'last_activity_at FROM users WHERE user_id=?',
            (target_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not viewer or not target:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "player_not_found"}
        if viewer["location"] != target["current_location"]:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "different_location"}
        last = _parse(target["last_activity_at"])
        if last is None:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "player_offline"}
        if current.tzinfo is None:
            current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        age = (current.astimezone(timezone.utc) - last).total_seconds()
        if age < 0 or age > PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:
            return {"success": False, "reason": "player_offline"}
        result = dict(target)
        result.update({"success": True, "online": True})
        return result
    finally:
        conn.close()

# ROM 12.3.0 PLAYER INTERACTION REQUESTS
PLAYER_INTERACTION_REQUEST_TYPES = frozenset(("trade", "duel"))
PLAYER_INTERACTION_REQUEST_STATUSES = frozenset(("pending", "accepted", "declined", "cancelled", "expired"))
PLAYER_INTERACTION_REQUEST_TTL_SECONDS = 120


def _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn):
    conn.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_interaction_requests (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            request_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(request_type IN ('trade','duel')),
            initiator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            location_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(
                status IN ('pending','accepted','declined','cancelled','expired')
            ),
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            responded_at TEXT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(initiator_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            CHECK(initiator_user_id <> recipient_user_id)
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_interaction_requests_recipient_status_expiry
            ON player_interaction_requests(recipient_user_id, status, expires_at);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_interaction_requests_initiator_status
            ON player_interaction_requests(initiator_user_id, status);
    """)


def init_player_interaction_requests(db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    expired = expire_stale_interaction_requests(db_path=db_path)
    return {"success": True, "table": "player_interaction_requests", "expired_requests": expired}


def _request_user_row(conn, user_id):
    columns = _users_column_names(conn)
    location_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("current_location", "location"))
    name_col = _pick_user_column(columns, ("character_name", "name", "username"))
    if location_col is None or name_col is None:
        raise RuntimeError("users location/name columns are unavailable")
    return conn.execute(
        f'SELECT user_id, "{name_col}" AS character_name, '
        f'"{location_col}" AS current_location, last_activity_at '
        f'FROM users WHERE user_id=?',
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchone()


def _row_online(row, current):
    last = _parse(row["last_activity_at"]) if row else None
    if last is None:
        return False
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    age = (current.astimezone(timezone.utc) - last).total_seconds()
    return 0 <= age <= PLAYER_ONLINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS


def get_interaction_request(request_id, *, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn)
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id,request_type,initiator_user_id,recipient_user_id,location_snapshot,"
            "status,revision,created_at,updated_at,expires_at,responded_at "
            "FROM player_interaction_requests WHERE id=?",
            (int(request_id),),
        ).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None
    finally:
        conn.close()


def create_player_interaction_request(initiator_user_id, recipient_user_id, request_type,
                                      *, ttl_seconds=PLAYER_INTERACTION_REQUEST_TTL_SECONDS,
                                      now=None, db_path=None, pve_busy_checker=None):
    """Atomically create a request and reserve both players' activity slots."""
    initiator = int(initiator_user_id)
    recipient = int(recipient_user_id)
    kind = str(request_type)
    if kind not in PLAYER_INTERACTION_REQUEST_TYPES:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "invalid_request_type"}
    if initiator == recipient:
        return {"success": False, "reason": "self_target"}
    current = now or _now()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    stamp = _text(current)
    expires = _text(current + timedelta(seconds=max(1, int(ttl_seconds))))
    if callable(pve_busy_checker):
        if pve_busy_checker(initiator) or pve_busy_checker(recipient):
            return {"success": False, "reason": "player_in_battle"}

    # ROM 12.3.2: stale sessions must never produce a false player_busy.
    cleanup_player_interaction_state(now=current, db_path=db_path)

    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn)
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at<=?",
            (stamp,),
        )
        a = _request_user_row(conn, initiator)
        b = _request_user_row(conn, recipient)
        if not a or not b:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "player_not_found"}
        if not _row_online(a, current) or not _row_online(b, current):
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "player_offline"}
        if not a["current_location"] or a["current_location"] != b["current_location"]:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "different_location"}
        busy = conn.execute(
            "SELECT user_id,activity_type,status FROM player_activity_sessions "
            "WHERE user_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY user_id", (initiator, recipient)
        ).fetchall()
        if busy:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "reason": "player_busy", "busy": [dict(x) for x in busy]}
        cur = conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO player_interaction_requests "
            "(request_type,initiator_user_id,recipient_user_id,location_snapshot,status,revision,"
            "created_at,updated_at,expires_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?, 'pending',1,?,?,?)",
            (kind, initiator, recipient, a["current_location"], stamp, stamp, expires),
        )
        request_id = int(cur.lastrowid)
        activity_type = f"{kind}_request"
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO player_activity_sessions "
            "(user_id,activity_type,reference_id,status,created_at,updated_at,expires_at) "
            "VALUES (?,?,?,'pending',?,?,?)",
            ((initiator, activity_type, request_id, stamp, stamp, expires),
             (recipient, activity_type, request_id, stamp, stamp, expires)),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return {
            "success": True, "request_id": request_id, "request_type": kind,
            "initiator_user_id": initiator, "recipient_user_id": recipient,
            "initiator_name": a["character_name"], "recipient_name": b["character_name"],
            "location": a["current_location"], "revision": 1, "expires_at": expires,
        }
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
        conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "integrity_error", "error": str(exc)}
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback(); raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def respond_to_player_interaction_request(request_id, actor_user_id, action,
                                          *, expected_revision=1, now=None,
                                          db_path=None, pve_busy_checker=None):
    """Accept or decline a pending request with actor, expiry and revision guards."""
    request_id = int(request_id); actor = int(actor_user_id); action = str(action)
    if action not in ("accept", "decline"):
        return {"success": False, "reason": "invalid_action"}
    current = now or _now()
    if current.tzinfo is None: current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    stamp = _text(current)
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn)
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM player_interaction_requests WHERE id=?", (request_id,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "request_not_found"}
        row = dict(row)
        if actor != int(row["recipient_user_id"]):
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "wrong_actor"}
        if row["status"] != "pending":
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "request_not_pending", "status": row["status"]}
        if int(row["revision"]) != int(expected_revision):
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "stale_revision"}
        expiry = _parse(row["expires_at"])
        if expiry is None or expiry <= current:
            conn.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='expired',updated_at=?,responded_at=? WHERE id=?", (stamp, stamp, request_id))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE reference_id=? AND activity_type=?", (request_id, f"{row['request_type']}_request"))
            conn.commit(); return {"success": False, "reason": "request_expired"}
        if action == "decline":
            conn.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='declined',updated_at=?,responded_at=? WHERE id=?", (stamp, stamp, request_id))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE reference_id=? AND activity_type=?", (request_id, f"{row['request_type']}_request"))
            conn.commit(); return {**row, "success": True, "status": "declined"}
        if callable(pve_busy_checker):
            if pve_busy_checker(int(row["initiator_user_id"])) or pve_busy_checker(int(row["recipient_user_id"])):
                conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "player_in_battle"}
        a = _request_user_row(conn, row["initiator_user_id"]); b = _request_user_row(conn, row["recipient_user_id"])
        if not a or not b:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "player_not_found"}
        if not _row_online(a,current) or not _row_online(b,current):
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "player_offline"}
        if a["current_location"] != row["location_snapshot"] or b["current_location"] != row["location_snapshot"]:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success": False, "reason": "different_location"}
        conn.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='accepted',updated_at=?,responded_at=? WHERE id=?", (stamp, stamp, request_id))
        # Request transition commits first; trade creation is idempotent and owns
        # the next transaction, activity lock and ten-minute editing timeout.
        conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE reference_id=? AND activity_type=?",
            (request_id, f"{row['request_type']}_request"),
        )
        conn.commit()
        if row["request_type"] == "trade":
            trade_result = create_player_trade_from_accepted_request(request_id, now=current, db_path=db_path)
            if not trade_result.get("success"):
                return {**row, "success": False, "reason": "trade_creation_failed", "trade_error": trade_result}
            return {**row, "success": True, "status": "accepted", "trade": trade_result}
        return {**row, "success": True, "status": "accepted"}
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback(); raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def cancel_player_interaction_request(request_id, actor_user_id, *, now=None, db_path=None):
    request_id=int(request_id); actor=int(actor_user_id); stamp=_text(now)
    conn=_connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        row=conn.execute("SELECT * FROM player_interaction_requests WHERE id=?",(request_id,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"reason":"request_not_found"}
        row=dict(row)
        if actor not in (int(row["initiator_user_id"]),int(row["recipient_user_id"])):
            conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"reason":"wrong_actor"}
        if row["status"] != "pending":
            conn.rollback(); return {"success":False,"reason":"request_not_pending","status":row["status"]}
        conn.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='cancelled',updated_at=?,responded_at=? WHERE id=?",(stamp,stamp,request_id))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE reference_id=? AND activity_type=?",(request_id,f"{row['request_type']}_request"))
        conn.commit(); return {**row,"success":True,"status":"cancelled"}
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback(); raise
    finally: conn.close()


def expire_stale_interaction_requests(*, now=None, db_path=None):
    stamp=_text(now); conn=_connect(db_path)
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE"); _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn)
        rows=conn.execute("SELECT id,request_type FROM player_interaction_requests WHERE status='pending' AND expires_at<=?",(stamp,)).fetchall()
        for row in rows:
            conn.execute("UPDATE player_interaction_requests SET status='expired',updated_at=?,responded_at=? WHERE id=?",(stamp,stamp,row["id"]))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions WHERE reference_id=? AND activity_type=?",(row["id"],f"{row['request_type']}_request"))
        conn.commit(); return len(rows)
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback(); raise
    finally: conn.close()

# ROM 12.3.2 INTERACTION SESSION TIMEOUT AND RECOVERY
PLACEHOLDER_ACCEPTED_TRADE_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 0
FUTURE_TRADE_EDITING_TTL_SECONDS = 600
FUTURE_TRADE_CONFIRMATION_TTL_SECONDS = 120


def _table_exists(conn, table_name):
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?",
        (str(table_name),),
    ).fetchone() is not None


def recover_orphan_player_activity_sessions(*, now=None, db_path=None):
    """Release stale request sessions and pre-editor accepted trade placeholders.

    Stage 12.3 has no player_trades table or offer editor yet. Therefore an
    accepted request must not retain permanent activity_type='trade' rows.
    Future real trades are preserved as soon as player_trades exists and owns
    the referenced trade session.
    """
    stamp = _text(now)
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    counters = {
        "expired_sessions": 0,
        "orphan_request_sessions": 0,
        "terminal_request_sessions": 0,
        "accepted_placeholder_trade_sessions": 0,
        "missing_user_sessions": 0,
    }
    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        request_table = _table_exists(conn, "player_interaction_requests")
        trade_table = _table_exists(conn, "player_trades")

        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
            "WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at<=?",
            (stamp,),
        )
        counters["expired_sessions"] = max(0, int(cur.rowcount))

        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
            "WHERE user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)"
        )
        counters["missing_user_sessions"] = max(0, int(cur.rowcount))

        if request_table:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
                "WHERE activity_type IN ('trade_request','duel_request') "
                "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                "  SELECT 1 FROM player_interaction_requests r "
                "  WHERE r.id=player_activity_sessions.reference_id"
                ")"
            )
            counters["orphan_request_sessions"] = max(0, int(cur.rowcount))

            cur = conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
                "WHERE activity_type IN ('trade_request','duel_request') "
                "AND EXISTS ("
                "  SELECT 1 FROM player_interaction_requests r "
                "  WHERE r.id=player_activity_sessions.reference_id "
                "  AND r.status IN ('accepted','declined','cancelled','expired')"
                ")"
            )
            counters["terminal_request_sessions"] = max(0, int(cur.rowcount))

            if not trade_table:
                cur = conn.execute(
                    "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
                    "WHERE activity_type='trade' "
                    "AND EXISTS ("
                    "  SELECT 1 FROM player_interaction_requests r "
                    "  WHERE r.id=player_activity_sessions.reference_id "
                    "  AND r.request_type='trade' AND r.status='accepted'"
                    ")"
                )
                counters["accepted_placeholder_trade_sessions"] = max(0, int(cur.rowcount))
            else:
                # Preserve only sessions backed by a real active player_trades row.
                cur = conn.execute(
                    "DELETE FROM player_activity_sessions "
                    "WHERE activity_type='trade' "
                    "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                    "  SELECT 1 FROM player_trades t "
                    "  WHERE t.id=player_activity_sessions.reference_id "
                    "  AND t.status IN ('editing','confirming','committing')"
                    ")"
                )
                counters["accepted_placeholder_trade_sessions"] = max(0, int(cur.rowcount))

        conn.commit()
        counters["total_removed"] = sum(counters.values())
        return {"success": True, **counters}
    except Exception:
        conn.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        conn.close()


def cleanup_player_interaction_state(*, now=None, db_path=None):
    """Canonical lightweight cleanup before availability/busy checks."""
    expired_requests = 0
    if _database_has_table("player_interaction_requests", db_path=db_path):
        expired_requests = expire_stale_interaction_requests(now=now, db_path=db_path)
    recovered = recover_orphan_player_activity_sessions(now=now, db_path=db_path)
    return {
        "success": True,
        "expired_requests": expired_requests,
        "recovery": recovered,
    }


def _database_has_table(table_name, *, db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        return _table_exists(conn, table_name)
    finally:
        conn.close()

# ROM 12.4.0 PLAYER TRADE DATABASE AND HISTORY FOUNDATION
PLAYER_TRADE_EDITING_TTL_SECONDS = 600
PLAYER_TRADE_CONFIRMATION_TTL_SECONDS = 120
PLAYER_TRADE_ACTIVE_STATUSES = frozenset(("editing", "confirming", "committing"))
PLAYER_TRADE_TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset(("completed", "cancelled", "expired", "failed"))


def _init_player_trade_schema(conn):
    conn.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_trades (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            request_id INTEGER NULL UNIQUE,
            initiator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            location_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'editing' CHECK(
                status IN ('editing','confirming','committing','completed','cancelled','expired','failed')
            ),
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            initiator_ready INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(initiator_ready IN (0,1)),
            recipient_ready INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(recipient_ready IN (0,1)),
            initiator_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(initiator_confirmed IN (0,1)),
            recipient_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(recipient_confirmed IN (0,1)),
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT NULL,
            cancelled_at TEXT NULL,
            cancel_reason TEXT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES player_interaction_requests(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(initiator_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
            FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
            CHECK(initiator_user_id <> recipient_user_id)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_trade_offers (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            trade_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            asset_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(asset_type IN ('stack','equipment','gold')),
            inventory_id INTEGER NULL,
            item_id INTEGER NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NULL,
            gold_amount REAL NULL,
            snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES player_trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
            FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
            CHECK(quantity IS NULL OR quantity > 0),
            CHECK(gold_amount IS NULL OR gold_amount >= 0)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_trade_events (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            trade_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            actor_user_id INTEGER NULL,
            event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
            payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES player_trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_trade_history (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            trade_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            initiator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('completed','cancelled','expired','failed')),
            initiator_offer_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            recipient_offer_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            summary_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT NULL,
            cancelled_at TEXT NULL,
            cancel_reason TEXT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(trade_id) REFERENCES player_trades(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trades_initiator_status
            ON player_trades(initiator_user_id, status);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trades_recipient_status
            ON player_trades(recipient_user_id, status);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trades_status_expiry
            ON player_trades(status, expires_at);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trade_offers_trade_owner
            ON player_trade_offers(trade_id, owner_user_id);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trade_events_trade_id
            ON player_trade_events(trade_id, id);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trade_history_initiator
            ON player_trade_history(initiator_user_id, id DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_player_trade_history_recipient
            ON player_trade_history(recipient_user_id, id DESC);
    """)


def init_player_trade_foundation(db_path=None):
    conn = _connect(db_path)
    try:
        _init_player_interaction_request_schema(conn)
        _init_player_trade_schema(conn)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    expired = expire_stale_player_trades(db_path=db_path)
    return {"success": True, "tables": ["player_trades", "player_trade_offers", "player_trade_events", "player_trade_history"], "expired_trades": expired}


def _trade_event(conn, trade_id, actor_user_id, event_type, revision, stamp, payload_json="{}"):
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO player_trade_events(trade_id,actor_user_id,event_type,revision,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
        (int(trade_id), actor_user_id, str(event_type), int(revision), str(payload_json), stamp),
    )


def _write_trade_history(conn, trade, status, stamp, reason=None):
    completed_at = stamp if status == "completed" else None
    cancelled_at = stamp if status in ("cancelled", "expired", "failed") else None
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO player_trade_history "
        "(trade_id,initiator_user_id,recipient_user_id,status,initiator_offer_snapshot,recipient_offer_snapshot,summary_json,created_at,completed_at,cancelled_at,cancel_reason) "
        "VALUES(?,?,?,?,'[]','[]','{}',?,?,?,?)",
