from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from systems.simulation.balance_analyzer import (
    AnalysisConfig,
    CLASSES,
    PROFILES,
    build_balance_report,
    build_execution_plan,
    execute_plan,
    inspect_execution_plan,
)
from systems.simulation.progression_wall_analyzer import build_progression_wall_report


def parse_csv(value, allowed):
    if value == "all":
        return tuple(allowed)
    result = tuple(item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip())
    if any(item not in allowed for item in result):
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"invalid value: {value}")
    return result


def write_json(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(path)


def write_balance_md(path, data):
    config = data["config"]
    execution = data.get("execution", {})
    lines = [
        "# PvE Balance Analysis 13.7.1",
        "",
        f"- Target level: **{config['target_level']}**",
        f"- Profiles: **{', '.join(config['profiles'])}**",
        f"- Seeds: **{len(config['seeds'])}**",
        f"- Main result runs: **{data['run_count']}**",
        f"- Unique scenarios executed/planned: **{execution.get('unique_scenarios', 0)}**",
        f"- Cache hits: **{execution.get('cache_hits', 0)}**",
        f"- Fresh runs: **{execution.get('fresh_runs', 0)}**",
        f"- Workers: **{execution.get('workers', 1)}**",
        f"- Inventory: **{config['inventory_capacity']}**",
        "",
        "## Class results",
        "",
        "| Class | Profile | Runs | Win rate | Death rate | Mean battles | Mean days | EXP/hour | Gold/hour | Lost items |",
        "|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
    ]
    for character_class, profiles in data["groups"].items():
        for profile, item in profiles.items():
            lines.append(
                f"| {character_class} | {profile} | {item['runs']} | "
                f"{item['win_rate']:.2%} | {item['death_rate']:.2%} | "
                f"{item['mean_battles']:.2f} | {item['mean_days']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['exp_per_elapsed_hour']:.2f} | {item['gold_per_elapsed_hour']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['mean_items_lost']:.2f} |"
            )
    if data.get("inventory_comparison"):
        lines.extend(
            [
                "",
                "## Inventory 40 vs 60",
                "",
                "| Slots | Full bag events | Lost items | City visits | Mean final gold |",
                "|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
            ]
        )
        for slots, item in data["inventory_comparison"].items():
            lines.append(
                f"| {slots} | {item['mean_full_bag_events']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['mean_items_lost']:.2f} | {item['mean_city_visits']:.2f} | "
                f"{item['mean_final_gold']:.2f} |"
            )
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def write_walls_md(path, data):
    lines = [
        "# Progression Wall Analysis 13.7.1",
        "",
        f"- Target level: **{data['target_level']}**",
        f"- Findings: **{len(data['findings'])}**",
        "",
        "## Findings",
    ]
    if not data["findings"]:
        lines.append("- No configured wall threshold was exceeded.")
    for finding in data["findings"]:
        lines.append(
            f"- [{finding['severity']}] {finding['class']} / {finding['profile']} / "
            f"{finding['from_level']}→{finding['to_level']}: "
            f"{'; '.join(finding['reasons'])}"
        )
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def write_checkpoint(path, config, plan_summary, execution=None, status="planned"):
    payload = {
        "schema": "rom.simulation.pve_analysis_checkpoint.v1",
        "version": "13.7.1",
        "status": status,
        "config": {
            "target_level": config.target_level,
            "profiles": list(config.profiles),
            "classes": list(config.classes),
            "seeds": list(config.seeds),
            "inventory_capacity": config.inventory_capacity,
            "compare_inventory": config.compare_inventory,
        },
        "plan": plan_summary,
        "execution": execution or {},
    }
    write_json(path, payload)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--target-level", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--profiles", default="regular")
    parser.add_argument("--classes", default="all")
    parser.add_argument("--seeds", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--seed-start", type=int, default=137000)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory", type=int, default=40, choices=(40, 60))
    parser.add_argument("--compare-inventory", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-walls", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-inventory-comparison", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=max(1, min((os.cpu_count() or 2) - 1, 4)))
    parser.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="MD")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.seeds < 1:
        parser.error("--seeds must be at least 1")
    if not 1 <= args.workers <= 8:
        parser.error("--workers must be between 1 and 8")

    profiles = parse_csv(args.profiles, PROFILES)
    classes = parse_csv(args.classes, CLASSES)
    seeds = tuple(range(args.seed_start, args.seed_start + args.seeds))
    compare_inventory = args.compare_inventory and not args.skip_inventory_comparison
    config = AnalysisConfig(
        args.target_level,
        profiles,
        classes,
        seeds,
        args.inventory,
        compare_inventory,
    )
    plan = build_execution_plan(
        config,
        include_walls=not args.skip_walls,
        include_inventory=compare_inventory,
    )
    summary = inspect_execution_plan(ROOT, plan, force=args.force)
    output = ROOT / args.output
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tag = f"l{args.target_level}_{'-'.join(profiles)}_{args.seeds}s"
    checkpoint = output / f"SIMULATION_PVE_ANALYSIS_CHECKPOINT_13_7_1_{tag}.json"
    write_checkpoint(checkpoint, config, summary)

    print("[PLAN] PvE balance analysis")
    print(f"- unique scenarios: {summary['unique_scenarios']}")
    print(f"- cache hits: {summary['cache_hits']}")
    print(f"- new simulations required: {summary['new_simulations']}")
    print(f"- workers: {args.workers}")
    print(f"- walls: {'NO' if args.skip_walls else 'YES'}")
    print(f"- inventory comparison: {'YES' if compare_inventory else 'NO'}")
    print(f"- checkpoint: {checkpoint.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    if args.plan_only:
        print("[OK] Plan-only mode completed; simulations were not started.")
        return

    def progress(done, total, spec, source, elapsed, eta):
        if done == total or done == 1 or done % max(1, total // 20) == 0:
            print(
                f"[progress] {done}/{total} {spec.character_class}/{spec.profile}/"
                f"L{spec.target_level}/slots={spec.inventory_capacity}/seed={spec.seed} "
                f"({source}) elapsed={elapsed:.1f}s eta={eta:.1f}s"
            )

    try:
        payloads, execution = execute_plan(
            ROOT,
            plan,
            workers=args.workers,
            force=args.force,
            progress=progress,
        )
    except RuntimeError as error:
        write_checkpoint(checkpoint, config, inspect_execution_plan(ROOT, plan), status="interrupted")
        print(f"[STOPPED] {error}")
        raise SystemExit(130)

    balance = build_balance_report(config, payloads, execution, include_inventory=compare_inventory)
    walls = None if args.skip_walls else build_progression_wall_report(config, payloads)

    balance_json = output / f"SIMULATION_PVE_BALANCE_13_7_1_{tag}.json"
    balance_md = output / f"SIMULATION_PVE_BALANCE_13_7_1_{tag}.md"
    write_json(balance_json, balance)
    write_balance_md(balance_md, balance)

    walls_json = walls_md = None
    if walls is not None:
        walls_json = output / f"SIMULATION_PROGRESSION_WALLS_13_7_1_{tag}.json"
        walls_md = output / f"SIMULATION_PROGRESSION_WALLS_13_7_1_{tag}.md"
        write_json(walls_json, walls)
        write_walls_md(walls_md, walls)

    write_checkpoint(checkpoint, config, summary, execution, status="completed")
    print("[OK] PvE balance and progression analysis 13.7.1")
    print(f"- unique scenarios: {execution['unique_scenarios']}")
    print(f"- cache hits: {execution['cache_hits']}")
    print(f"- fresh runs: {execution['fresh_runs']}")
    print(f"- workers: {execution['workers']}")
    print(f"- elapsed seconds: {execution['elapsed_seconds']}")
    print(f"- wall findings: {0 if walls is None else len(walls['findings'])}")
    print(f"- balance JSON: {balance_json.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print(f"- balance Markdown: {balance_md.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    if walls_json:
        print(f"- walls JSON: {walls_json.relative_to(ROOT)}")
        print(f"- walls Markdown: {walls_md.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print(f"- checkpoint: {checkpoint.relative_to(ROOT)}")
    print("- database writes: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from systems.simulation.production_parity import run_required_parity, source_dependency_report


def main():
    parity = run_required_parity()
    dependencies = source_dependency_report()
    output = Path("MD")
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (output / "SIMULATION_CANONICAL_RULES_PARITY_13_2_0.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(parity, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8"
    )
    lines = [
        "# Simulation Canonical Rules Parity 13.2.0", "",
        f"Verdict: **{parity['verdict']}**", "",
        f"- Cases: **{parity['cases']}**",
        f"- Passed: **{parity['passed']}**",
        f"- Failed: **{parity['failed']}**",
        f"- Result SHA-256: `{parity['sha256']}`", "",
        "## Canonical sources", "",
    ]
    for item in dependencies["rules"]:
        lines.append(f"- `{item['rule']}` -> `{item['qualified_name']}` `{item['signature']}` at line {item['source_line']}; RNG injected: `{item['rng_injected']}`")
    failed = [item for item in parity["results"] if not item["passed"]]
    lines += ["", "## Findings", ""]
    if failed:
        for item in failed:
            lines.append(f"- `{item['case_id']}`: {item['error']}")
    else:
        lines.append("- No parity findings.")
    (output / "SIMULATION_CANONICAL_RULES_PARITY_13_2_0.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    if parity["verdict"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(2)
    print("[OK] Canonical parity report generated")
    print(f"- cases: {parity['cases']}")
    print("- verdict: PASS")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import sys

# Direct execution with `python tools/run_world_progression_sim.py` places the
# tools directory, not the ROM root, at sys.path[0]. Add the project root before
# importing the systems package. This is local to this CLI process.
PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT))

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
from systems.simulation.progression_reporting import write_progression_report
from systems.simulation.world_progression import WorldProgressionSimulator

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("character_class")
    parser.add_argument("target_level",type=int)
    parser.add_argument("profile",choices=("casual","regular","hardcore"))
    parser.add_argument("--seed",type=int,default=136000)
    parser.add_argument("--inventory",type=int,choices=(40,60),default=40)
    parser.add_argument("--output",default="simulation_reports")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    result=WorldProgressionSimulator(Path.cwd(),args.character_class,args.target_level,args.profile,args.seed,args.inventory).run()
    json_path,md_path=write_progression_report(result,Path(args.output))
    print("[OK] World progression simulation")
    print(f"- status: {result.status}")
    print(f"- level: {result.final_level}/{result.target_level}")
    print(f"- days: {result.days}")
    print(f"- battles: {result.battles}; wins: {result.wins}; deaths: {result.deaths}")
    print(f"- JSON: {json_path}")
    print(f"- Markdown: {md_path}")
    if result.status != "completed": raise SystemExit(2)
if __name__=="__main__":main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Isolated in-memory contracts for Auction lifecycle duplicates."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import json
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
import db
from systems import auction_house_system as auction

TARGETS=("init_auction_house","update_expired_auction_lots")
NOW="2030-01-15T12:00:00"
PAST="2030-01-01T12:00:00"
FUTURE="2030-02-01T12:00:00"
OLD_DELETE="2030-01-10T12:00:00"
FUTURE_DELETE="2030-02-10T12:00:00"


def fail(message):
 print(f"[FAIL] {message}"); raise SystemExit(1)

def parse_defs(path):
 text=path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"); tree=ast.parse(text,filename=str(path)); result={}
 for node in tree.body:
  if isinstance(node,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef)): result.setdefault(node.name,[]).append(node)
 return text,result

def insert_lot(cursor, seller, status, expires_at, delete_after=None, sold_at=None, suffix="x"):
 now="2030-01-01T00:00:00"
 cursor.execute(
  """INSERT INTO auction_lots (
  seller_user_id,buyer_user_id,item_type,item_source,item_ref_id,item_snapshot_json,
  item_name,item_name_norm,category,rarity,level,enhancement_level,durability_current,
  durability_max,quantity,price,status,created_at,expires_at,sold_at,claimed_at,
  delete_after,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
  (seller,None,"equipment","fixture",None,json.dumps({"fixture":suffix}),
   f"fixture-{suffix}",f"fixture-{suffix}","equipment","common",1,0,100,100,1,
   "10.00",status,now,expires_at,sold_at,None,delete_after,now),
 )
 return int(cursor.lastrowid)
def status(cursor,lot_id):
 row=cursor.execute("SELECT status,delete_after,updated_at FROM auction_lots WHERE id=?",(lot_id,)).fetchone()
 return tuple(row) if row else None

def main():
 db_text,db_defs=parse_defs(ROOT/"db.py")
 system_text,system_defs=parse_defs(ROOT/"systems"/"auction_house_system.py")
 for name in TARGETS:
  if len(db_defs.get(name,[]))!=1: fail(f"db.py {name}: definitions={len(db_defs.get(name,[]))}, expected 1 after i8b")
  if len(system_defs.get(name,[]))<1: fail(f"auction_house_system.py missing {name}")
  final=ast.get_source_segment(db_text,db_defs[name][-1]) or ""
  if "auction_house_system" not in final: fail(f"final db.{name} is not Auction System wrapper")

 real_conn=auction.conn; real_cursor=auction.cursor
 memory=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
 memory.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
 cursor=memory.cursor()
 auction.conn=memory; auction.cursor=cursor
 checks=0
 try:
  # Public init delegates to the isolated system connection and is idempotent.
  if db.init_auction_house() is not True: fail("public init return contract failed")
  if db.init_auction_house() is not True: fail("second public init return contract failed")
  tables={r[0] for r in cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()}
  if not {"auction_lots","auction_history"}.issubset(tables): fail("auction schema initialization failed")
  checks+=3

  active_expired=insert_lot(cursor,-90120801,"ACTIVE",PAST,suffix="active-expired")
  active_future=insert_lot(cursor,-90120802,"ACTIVE",FUTURE,suffix="active-future")
  expired_old=insert_lot(cursor,-90120803,"EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED",PAST,OLD_DELETE,suffix="expired-old")
  expired_future=insert_lot(cursor,-90120804,"EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED",PAST,FUTURE_DELETE,suffix="expired-future")
  sold_old=insert_lot(cursor,-90120805,"SOLD_UNCLAIMED",PAST,OLD_DELETE,PAST,"sold-old")
  sold_claimed=insert_lot(cursor,-90120806,"SOLD_CLAIMED",PAST,OLD_DELETE,PAST,"sold-claimed")
  expired_missing=insert_lot(cursor,-90120807,"EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED",PAST,None,suffix="expired-missing-delete")
  memory.commit()

  result=db.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  required={"success","now","expired_active","deleted_expired_unclaimed","deleted_sold_unclaimed","fixed_missing_delete_after"}
  if not isinstance(result,dict) or not required.issubset(result): fail(f"cleanup result contract failed: {result!r}")
  if result["success"] is not True or result["now"]!=NOW: fail("cleanup success/now contract failed")
  if int(result["expired_active"])!=1: fail(f"expired_active={result['expired_active']}, expected 1")
  if int(result["deleted_expired_unclaimed"])!=1: fail("expired-unclaimed deletion count failed")
  if int(result["deleted_sold_unclaimed"])!=1: fail("sold-unclaimed deletion count failed")
  if int(result["fixed_missing_delete_after"])!=1: fail("missing delete_after fix count failed")
  checks+=6

  if status(cursor,active_expired)[0]!="EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED": fail("expired ACTIVE transition failed")
  if not status(cursor,active_expired)[1]: fail("expired ACTIVE delete_after missing")
  if status(cursor,active_future)[0]!="ACTIVE": fail("future ACTIVE lot changed")
  if status(cursor,expired_old)[0]!="DELETED": fail("old EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED not deleted")
  if status(cursor,expired_future)[0]!="EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED": fail("future retained lot changed")
  if status(cursor,sold_old)[0]!="DELETED": fail("old SOLD_UNCLAIMED not deleted")
  if status(cursor,sold_claimed)[0]!="SOLD_CLAIMED": fail("claimed sale changed")
  if not status(cursor,expired_missing)[1]: fail("missing delete_after was not repaired")
  checks+=8

  # Same timestamp must be idempotent.
  second=db.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  for key in ("expired_active","deleted_expired_unclaimed","deleted_sold_unclaimed","fixed_missing_delete_after"):
   if int(second.get(key,-1))!=0: fail(f"idempotency failed for {key}: {second.get(key)}")
  checks+=4

  # Direct system path and public wrapper must return the same empty delta now.
  direct=auction.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  public=db.update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=NOW)
  if direct!=public: fail(f"public/system cleanup mismatch: {public!r} != {direct!r}")
  checks+=1
 finally:
  auction.conn=real_conn; auction.cursor=real_cursor
  memory.close()

 # Real project connection was never replaced or mutated.
 if auction.conn is not real_conn or auction.cursor is not real_cursor: fail("Auction globals were not restored")
 print("[OK] auction lifecycle isolated contracts")
 print(f"- lifecycle checks: {checks}")
 print("- schema init idempotency: OK")
 print("- ACTIVE expiration transition: OK")
 print("- unclaimed retention deletion: OK")
 print("- claimed/future lot preservation: OK")
 print("- cleanup idempotency: OK")
 print("- public/system comparison: OK")
 print("- real database mutations: 0")
if __name__=="__main__": main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations
import ast, sqlite3, sys, tempfile
from contextlib import closing
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
def fail(x): print(f"[FAIL] {x}"); raise SystemExit(1)
def main():
    for rel in ("systems/auction_house_system.py","handlers/auction_house.py","db.py"):
        p=ROOT/rel; ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"),filename=str(p))
    s=(ROOT/"systems/auction_house_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    h=(ROOT/"handlers/auction_house.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    for value in ("AUCTION_CATEGORY_RUNE = \"rune\"","AUCTION_PROTECTED_TRANSFER_ITEM_IDS","_auction_is_rune_snapshot_12_6_3c","_auction_trade_reserved_quantity_12_6_3c"):
        if value not in s: fail("missing system contract: "+value)
    for value in ("💠 Руни","AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_BUTTONS_V2[\"rune\"]","AUCTION_BUY_CATEGORY_BUTTONS_V1[\"rune\"]"):
        if value not in h: fail("missing handler contract: "+value)
    # Validate the protected-lot migration result against a synthetic database.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rom_auction_12_6_3c_",ignore_cleanup_errors=True) as td:
        db=Path(td)/"test.db"
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(db)) as c:
            c.executescript("CREATE TABLE auction_lots(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,item_snapshot_json TEXT,status TEXT,delete_after TEXT,updated_at TEXT); INSERT INTO auction_lots VALUES(1,'{\"item_id\":526}','ACTIVE',NULL,'x'); INSERT INTO auction_lots VALUES(2,'{\"item_id\":527}','ACTIVE',NULL,'x');")
            protected=[]
            for row in c.execute("SELECT id,item_snapshot_json FROM auction_lots WHERE status='ACTIVE'"):
                if int(__import__('json').loads(row[1]).get('item_id') or 0) in (301,402,526,528): protected.append(row[0])
            if protected != [1]: fail(protected)
    print("[OK] Auction rune category and transfer policy alignment contracts")
    print("- rune sell/buy category and pagination routing: OK")
    print("- runes excluded from material matcher: OK")
    print("- protected IDs 301/402/526/528 blocked: OK")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Read-only contracts for removal of obsolete base captures."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

DB_PATH = ROOT / "game.db"
DB_PY = ROOT / "db.py"
CAPTURES = (
    "_base_get_inventory_detailed_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_inventory_entry_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_item_by_inventory_id_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_item_by_inventory_id_full_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_max_hp_before_refine_v1",
    "_base_get_sellable_equipment_items_before_refine_display_v1",
    "_base_get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id_before_refine_v1",
    "_base_get_weapon_damage_for_refine_hotfix_v1",
)
REQUIRED_PUBLIC_APIS = (
    "get_inventory_detailed",
    "get_inventory_entry",
    "get_item_by_inventory_id",
    "get_item_by_inventory_id_full",
    "get_max_hp",
    "get_sellable_equipment_items",
    "get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id",
)


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def fingerprint():
    return (
        hashlib.sha256(DB_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        DB_PATH.stat().st_size,
        DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns,
    )


def main():
    before = fingerprint()
    source = DB_PY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(DB_PY))

    residual = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and node.id in CAPTURES:
            residual.append((node.id, node.lineno, "name"))
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str) and node.value in CAPTURES:
            residual.append((node.value, node.lineno, "string"))
    if residual:
        fail(f"removed captures still occur in source: {residual}")

    import db

    runtime_residual = [name for name in CAPTURES if hasattr(db, name)]
    if runtime_residual:
        fail(f"removed captures still exist at runtime: {runtime_residual}")

    missing_public = [name for name in REQUIRED_PUBLIC_APIS if not callable(getattr(db, name, None))]
    if missing_public:
        fail(f"public APIs missing after cleanup: {missing_public}")

    # Read-only runtime probes against a real existing user when available.
    row = db.conn.execute("SELECT user_id FROM users ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 1").fetchone()
    user_id = int(row[0]) if row else None
    probes = {}
    if user_id is not None:
        probes["inventory_detailed_type"] = type(db.get_inventory_detailed(user_id)).__name__
        probes["sellable_equipment_type"] = type(db.get_sellable_equipment_items(user_id)).__name__
        probes["max_hp_type"] = type(db.get_max_hp(user_id)).__name__

        inventory_row = db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1",
            (user_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if inventory_row:
            inventory_id = int(inventory_row[0])
            probes["inventory_entry_type"] = type(
                db.get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)
            ).__name__
            probes["item_by_inventory_type"] = type(
                db.get_item_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)
            ).__name__
            probes["item_by_inventory_full_type"] = type(
                db.get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
            ).__name__

    if before != fingerprint():
        fail("game.db changed during read-only contracts")

    print("[OK] capture-only cleanup contracts")
    print(f"- removed source captures: {len(CAPTURES)}")
    print("- removed runtime globals: 8")
    print(f"- required public APIs callable: {len(REQUIRED_PUBLIC_APIS)}")
    print(f"- read-only runtime probes: {probes}")
    print("- gameplay functions removed: 0")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def sequence(values):
    iterator = iter(values)
    return lambda: next(iterator)


def logical_db_fingerprint():
    uri = f"file:{(ROOT / 'game.db').as_posix()}?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        )]
        for table in tables:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            rows = [list(row) for row in conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {quoted}")]
            rows.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            digest.update(json.dumps([table, rows], ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8"))
        return digest.hexdigest()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def main():

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0
    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


def legacy_selection(mob, rng):
    is_elite = bool(mob.get("is_elite", False))
    chance = 0.45 if is_elite else 0.20
    if rng() > chance:
        return None
    rarity_roll = rng()
    if is_elite:
        rarity = "uncommon" if rarity_roll <= 0.75 else "rare"
        class_aware = 0.70
    else:
        rarity = "common" if rarity_roll <= 0.80 else "uncommon"
        class_aware = 0.50
    return rarity, class_aware


def compare(name, mob, values):
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_equipment_drop
    old_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    new_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    old = legacy_selection(mob, old_rng)
    central = roll_central_equipment_drop(mob, new_rng)
    new = None
    if central.get("rolled"):
        new = (
            central["payload"]["rarity"],
            central["payload"]["class_aware_chance"],
        )
    if old != new:
        fail(f"{name}: old={old}, new={new}, central={central}")
    if old_rng.calls != new_rng.calls:
        fail(f"{name}: RNG calls {old_rng.calls} != {new_rng.calls}")


def main():
    from data.drop_tables import CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES, DROP_RULES_BY_ID
    from systems.drop_system import (
        get_central_drop_status, roll_central_equipment_drop,
        validate_drop_tables,
    )

    rule = DROP_RULES_BY_ID["equipment"]
    if tuple(CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES) != ("rune", "refine_stone", "equipment", "trophy", "potion"):
        fail(f"migrated rules mismatch: {CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES}")
    if rule["enemy"] != {
        "normal": {"chance": 0.20},
        "elite": {"chance": 0.45},
        "boss": {"chance": 0.70},
    }:
        fail(f"equipment chances mismatch: {rule['enemy']}")
    if rule["rarity_weights"] != {
        "normal": (("common", 0.80), ("uncommon", 0.20)),
        "elite": (("uncommon", 0.75), ("rare", 0.25)),
        "boss": (("rare", 0.85), ("epic", 0.15)),
    }:
        fail(f"rarity weights mismatch: {rule['rarity_weights']}")
    if rule["class_aware_chance"] != {
        "normal": 0.50, "elite": 0.70, "boss": 0.90,
    }:
        fail(f"class-aware chances mismatch: {rule['class_aware_chance']}")
    if not rule.get("production_enabled") or not validate_drop_tables()["success"]:
        fail("equipment production/schema contract failed")

    cases = (
        ("normal chance boundary hit", {}, (0.20, 0.0)),
        ("normal chance miss", {}, (0.200001,)),
        ("normal common boundary", {}, (0.0, 0.80)),
        ("normal uncommon", {}, (0.0, 0.800001)),
        ("elite chance boundary hit", {"is_elite": True}, (0.45, 0.0)),
        ("elite chance miss", {"is_elite": True}, (0.450001,)),
        ("elite uncommon boundary", {"is_elite": True}, (0.0, 0.75)),
        ("elite rare", {"is_elite": True}, (0.0, 0.750001)),
    )
    for name, mob, values in cases:
        compare(name, mob, values)

    for enemy_type, mob in (
        ("normal", {}), ("elite", {"is_elite": True}),
    ):
        source = random.Random(114000 + len(enemy_type))
        for index in range(10000):
            compare(
                f"{enemy_type} exact {index}", mob,
                (source.random(), source.random()),
            )

    boss_cases = (
        ({"is_boss": True, "is_elite": True}, (0.70, 0.85), "rare"),
        ({"boss": True}, (0.0, 0.850001), "epic"),
        ({"enemy_type": "boss"}, (0.700001,), None),
    )
    for mob, values, rarity in boss_cases:
        result = roll_central_equipment_drop(mob, CountingRandom(values))
        actual = result["payload"]["rarity"] if result.get("rolled") else None
        if actual != rarity or result["enemy_type"] != "boss":
            fail(f"boss case mismatch: {result}")

    for enemy_type, mob, target in (
        ("normal", {}, 0.20),
        ("elite", {"is_elite": True}, 0.45),
        ("boss", {"is_boss": True}, 0.70),
    ):
        rng = random.Random(114100 + len(enemy_type))
        hits = sum(
            bool(roll_central_equipment_drop(mob, rng.random).get("rolled"))
            for _ in range(100000)
        )
        actual = hits / 100000
        if abs(actual - target) > 0.008:
            fail(f"{enemy_type} rate {actual} vs {target}")

    status = get_central_drop_status()
    if status["production_rules"] != ["equipment", "trophy", "refine_stone", "rune", "potion"]:
        fail(f"production status mismatch: {status}")

    reward = (ROOT / "systems" / "reward_system.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(reward)
    functions = [
        node for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "roll_equipment_drop"
    ]
    if len(functions) != 1 or "roll_central_equipment_drop" not in reward:
        fail("final equipment compatibility API missing or duplicated")
    if "process_enemy_drops" not in reward:
        fail("final central victory integration is missing")

    print("- elite: 45%, uncommon 75% / rare 25%, class-aware 70%")

    print("- boss priority over elite: OK")
    print("- existing equipment creator remains authoritative: OK")

from pathlib import Path

def fail(message): print(f"[FAIL] {message}"); raise SystemExit(1)
class Sequence:
    def __init__(self, values): self.values=iter(values); self.calls=0
    def __call__(self): self.calls+=1; return next(self.values)

def main():
    from data.drop_tables import CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES,DROP_RULES_BY_ID
    from systems.drop_system import get_central_drop_status,roll_central_potion_drop,validate_drop_tables
    rule=DROP_RULES_BY_ID['potion']
    if tuple(CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES)!=("rune","refine_stone","equipment","trophy","potion"):
        fail(CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES)
    expected_chances={"normal":0.06,"elite":0.19,"boss":0.45}
    if {k:v['chance'] for k,v in rule['enemy'].items()}!=expected_chances: fail(rule['enemy'])
    expected_weights={
      "normal":((201,4/6),(202,2/6)),
      "elite":((201,10/19),(202,6/19),(203,2/19),(204,1/19)),
      "boss":((201,20/45),(202,12/45),(203,8/45),(204,5/45)),
    }
    for enemy,weights in expected_weights.items():
        actual=rule['item_weights'][enemy]
        if len(actual)!=len(weights) or any(a[0]!=b[0] or abs(a[1]-b[1])>1e-12 for a,b in zip(actual,weights)):
            fail(f"{enemy} weights={actual}")
    if not rule.get('enabled') or not rule.get('production_enabled'): fail('potion rule disabled')
    validation=validate_drop_tables()
    if not validation['success']: fail(validation['errors'])

    # Inclusive group boundaries and at-most-one contract.
    for mob,chance in (({},0.06),({'is_elite':True},0.19),({'is_boss':True},0.45)):
        hit=roll_central_potion_drop(mob,Sequence((chance,0.0)))
        miss=roll_central_potion_drop(mob,Sequence((chance+0.000001,)))
        if not hit['rolled'] or miss['rolled']: fail((hit,miss))
        if hit['payload']['quantity']!=1: fail(hit)

    # 100k simulations per enemy type; check total and individual marginal rates.
    targets={
      'normal':({201:0.04,202:0.02},{}),
      'elite':({201:0.10,202:0.06,203:0.02,204:0.01},{'is_elite':True}),
      'boss':({201:0.20,202:0.12,203:0.08,204:0.05},{'is_boss':True}),
    }
    for enemy,(expected,mob) in targets.items():
        rng=random.Random(116000+len(enemy)); counts=Counter(); none=0
        for _ in range(100000):
            result=roll_central_potion_drop(mob,rng.random)
            if result['rolled']: counts[result['payload']['item_id']]+=1
            else: none+=1
        if sum(counts.values())>100000: fail('more than one potion per kill')
        for item_id,target in expected.items():
            actual=counts[item_id]/100000
            if abs(actual-target)>0.008: fail(f"{enemy} item {item_id}: {actual} vs {target}")

    status=get_central_drop_status()
    if status['production_rules']!=['equipment','trophy','refine_stone','rune','potion']:
        fail(status)
    if DROP_RULES_BY_ID['success_rune'].get('production_enabled'): fail('success rune enabled')
    if DROP_RULES_BY_ID['perfect_extractor'].get('production_enabled'): fail('perfect extractor enabled')

    reward=(ROOT/'systems/reward_system.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    tree=ast.parse(reward)
    names=[n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef)]
    if names.count('roll_potion_drop') != 1 or names.count('process_enemy_drops') != 1: fail('final potion integration missing or duplicated')
    if 'process_enemy_drops' not in reward: fail('final central integration missing')

    print('[OK] Central potion drop balance contracts')
    print('- normal: total 6% = small HP 4% + small MP 2%')
    print('- elite: total 19% = 10% + 6% + 2% + 1%')
    print('- boss: total 45% = 20% + 12% + 8% + 5%')
    print('- mutually exclusive: maximum one potion per victory')
    print('- item IDs 201/202/203/204: OK')
    print('- inclusive chance boundaries: OK')
    print('- Rune of Success and Perfect Extractor remain disabled')

def logical_db_fingerprint():

def cleanup(db):
    # Remove the isolated fixture from every current/future user-owned table.
    # Stage 11 adds systems over time, so a hard-coded three-table cleanup is
    # no longer sufficient for a whole-database logical fingerprint.
    tables = [
        row[0] for row in db.conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        ).fetchall()
    ]
    owned = []
    for table in tables:
        try:
            columns = {
                str(row[1]) for row in db.conn.execute(
                    f'PRAGMA table_info("{table}")'
                ).fetchall()
            }
            if "user_id" in columns and table != "users":
                owned.append(table)
        except Exception:
            pass
    # Repeat to tolerate foreign-key dependency order between owned tables.
    for _ in range(3):
        for table in owned:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            try:
                db.conn.execute(
                    f"DELETE FROM {quoted} WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,)
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
    db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (USER_ID,))
    db.conn.commit()


def compare_legacy_case(name, mob, value):
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_refine_stone_drop
    from systems.reward_system import (
        ELITE_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE,
        NORMAL_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE,
    )

    legacy_rng = CountingRandom((value,))
    central_rng = CountingRandom((value,))
    legacy_chance = (
        ELITE_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE
        if bool(mob.get("is_elite", False))
        else NORMAL_REFINE_STONE_DROP_CHANCE
    )
    legacy_hit = float(legacy_rng()) <= float(legacy_chance)
    central = roll_central_refine_stone_drop(mob, central_rng)
    if bool(central.get("rolled")) != legacy_hit:
        fail(f"{name}: legacy={legacy_hit}, central={central}")
    if legacy_rng.calls != central_rng.calls or central_rng.calls != 1:
        fail(f"{name}: RNG calls differ")

    if boss_miss.get("rolled") or boss_miss["enemy_type"] != "boss":

    for enemy_type, mob, target in (

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import random
import sqlite3
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0

    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


def logical_db_fingerprint():
    uri = f"file:{(ROOT / 'game.db').as_posix()}?mode=ro"
    conn = sqlite3.connect(uri, uri=True)
    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        tables = [row[0] for row in conn.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' "
            "AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
        )]
        for table in tables:
            quoted = '"' + str(table).replace('"', '""') + '"'
            rows = [list(row) for row in conn.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {quoted}")]
            rows.sort(key=lambda row: json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
            digest.update(json.dumps([table, rows], ensure_ascii=False, default=str).encode("utf-8"))
        return digest.hexdigest()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def comparable(result):
    keys = (
        "dropped", "enemy_type", "chance", "roll", "item_id", "name",
        "stat", "level", "quantity",
    )
    return {key: result.get(key) for key in keys if key in result}


def compare_case(name, mob, values):
    from systems.rune_system import (
        _legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0,
        roll_rune_drop,
    )

    legacy_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    central_rng = CountingRandom(values)
    legacy = _legacy_roll_rune_drop_11_10_0(mob, random_func=legacy_rng)
    central = roll_rune_drop(mob, random_func=central_rng)
    if comparable(legacy) != comparable(central):
        fail(f"{name}: result mismatch\nlegacy={legacy}\ncentral={central}")
    if legacy_rng.calls != central_rng.calls:
        fail(f"{name}: random draw mismatch {legacy_rng.calls} != {central_rng.calls}")
    return central, central_rng.calls

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


class CountingRandom:
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = iter(values)
        self.calls = 0
    def __call__(self):
        self.calls += 1
        return next(self.values)


class CountingChoice:
    def __init__(self, index=0):
        self.index = index
        self.calls = 0
    def __call__(self, values):
        self.calls += 1
        return values[self.index % len(values)]


def legacy_simple(mob, rng, chooser):
    possible = []
    if "trash_item_id" in mob:
        possible.append(mob["trash_item_id"])
    if "loot_item_id" in mob:
        possible.append(mob["loot_item_id"])
    if "trash_items" in mob and isinstance(mob["trash_items"], list):
        possible.extend(mob["trash_items"])
    if "trash_drops" in mob and isinstance(mob["trash_drops"], list):
        possible.extend(mob["trash_drops"])
    if not possible:
        return None
    chance = float(mob.get("loot_chance", 0.45))
    if mob.get("is_elite"):
        chance = min(1.0, chance + 0.20)
    if rng() > chance:
        return None
    return chooser(possible)


def compare_simple(name, mob, value, choice_index=0):
    from systems.drop_system import roll_central_trophy_simple
    old_rng, new_rng = CountingRandom((value,)), CountingRandom((value,))
    old_choice, new_choice = CountingChoice(choice_index), CountingChoice(choice_index)
    old = legacy_simple(mob, old_rng, old_choice)
    central = roll_central_trophy_simple(mob, new_rng, new_choice)
    new = central["payload"]["item_id"] if central.get("rolled") else None
    if old != new:
        fail(f"{name}: old={old}, new={new}, central={central}")
    if (old_rng.calls, old_choice.calls) != (new_rng.calls, new_choice.calls):
        fail(f"{name}: RNG/choice call mismatch")


def main():
    from data.drop_tables import CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES, DROP_RULES_BY_ID

        get_central_drop_status,

    )

    if tuple(CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES) != (
        "rune", "refine_stone", "equipment", "trophy", "potion"
    ):
        fail(f"migrated rules mismatch: {CENTRAL_DROP_MIGRATED_RULES}")
    rule = DROP_RULES_BY_ID["trophy"]

        fail(validate_drop_tables()["errors"])

        ("elite hit", {"trash_items": [107], "loot_chance": 0.45, "is_elite": True}, 0.65, 0),
        ("elite miss", {"trash_items": [107], "loot_chance": 0.45, "is_elite": True}, 0.650001, 0),
        ("empty pool", {}, 0.0, 0),
    )
    for case in cases:

        fail(f"boss compatibility policy mismatch: {boss_plain}, {boss_elite}")
    if boss_elite["enemy_type"] != "boss":
        fail("boss priority over elite failed")

    # Legacy table-entry boundary uses inclusive <= chance.
    table_hit = roll_central_trophy_table_entry(
        {"item_id": 201, "chance": 0.25}, CountingRandom((0.25,))
    )
    table_miss = roll_central_trophy_table_entry(
        {"item_id": 201, "chance": 0.25}, CountingRandom((0.250001,))

    if not table_hit["rolled"] or table_miss["rolled"]:

TEST_USER_ID=-90120501
SECOND_USER_ID=-90120502


def fail(message):

def cleanup():
    for uid in (TEST_USER_ID,SECOND_USER_ID):
        for table in ("equipment_slots","inventory","user_active_contracts","user_daily_quests"):
            try: db.cursor.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE user_id=?",(uid,))
            except Exception: pass
        db.cursor.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id=?",(uid,))
    db.conn.commit()

    db.cursor.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO users (
            user_id,hp,max_hp,level,exp,gold,kills,bag_slots,current_location,

            character_class,class_change_available,mp,max_mp
        ) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
        """,
        (uid,170,170,3,0,0,0,40,"start_path",10,10,12,11,10,0,"","",0,0,0),
    )
    db.conn.commit()

        "SELECT character_name,character_class,class_change_available,mp,max_mp FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (uid,),
    ).fetchone()
    return tuple(row) if row else None

    ).fetchall()

    insert_user(TEST_USER_ID)
    insert_user(SECOND_USER_ID)
    checks=0

        generated_name=str(abs(TEST_USER_ID))
        normalized=db.normalize_character_name("  "+generated_name+"  ")
        if normalized!=generated_name: fail("name normalization contract failed")
        valid,message=db.validate_character_name(generated_name)
        if valid is not True or message!="": fail("valid name contract failed")
        checks+=2

        result=db.set_character_name(TEST_USER_ID,"  "+generated_name+"  ")
        if not isinstance(result,dict) or result.get("success") is not True: fail("set_character_name success contract failed")
        if db.get_character_name(TEST_USER_ID)!=generated_name: fail("character name persistence failed")
        if cs.is_character_name_taken(generated_name,exclude_user_id=TEST_USER_ID): fail("exclude_user_id uniqueness contract failed")
        duplicate=db.set_character_name(SECOND_USER_ID,generated_name)
        if not isinstance(duplicate,dict) or duplicate.get("success") is not False: fail("duplicate name rejection failed")
        invalid=db.set_character_name(TEST_USER_ID,"")
        if not isinstance(invalid,dict) or invalid.get("success") is not False: fail("invalid name rejection failed")
        checks+=5

        mana_classes=[key for key,cfg in CLASS_CONFIGS.items() if cfg.get("resource")=="mana"]
        non_mana_classes=[key for key,cfg in CLASS_CONFIGS.items() if cfg.get("resource")!="mana"]
        if not mana_classes or not non_mana_classes: fail("required class fixtures not available")
        mana_key=mana_classes[0]; non_mana_key=non_mana_classes[0]

        class_result=db.set_character_class(TEST_USER_ID,mana_key)
        if not isinstance(class_result,dict) or class_result.get("success") is not True: fail("set mana class contract failed")
        if db.get_character_class(TEST_USER_ID)!=mana_key: fail("class persistence failed")
        if db.get_character_class_display(TEST_USER_ID)!=CLASS_CONFIGS[mana_key]["name"]: fail("class display contract failed")
        if db.get_character_resource_type(TEST_USER_ID)!="mana": fail("resource type contract failed")
        unknown=db.set_character_class(TEST_USER_ID,"__invalid_class_key__")
        if not isinstance(unknown,dict) or unknown.get("success") is not False: fail("unknown class rejection failed")
        checks+=5

        maximum=db.get_max_mp(TEST_USER_ID)
        if not isinstance(maximum,int) or maximum<=0: fail("mana max MP contract failed")
        # Public keyword contract uses mp=; system implementation uses amount=.
        if db.set_user_mp(TEST_USER_ID,mp=maximum+100)!=maximum: fail("public mp keyword/clamp contract failed")
        mp_info=db.get_user_mp(TEST_USER_ID)
        required={"mp","max_mp","current_mp"}
        if not isinstance(mp_info,dict) or not required.issubset(mp_info): fail("get_user_mp dictionary contract failed")
        if mp_info["mp"]!=maximum or mp_info["max_mp"]!=maximum: fail("get_user_mp values failed")
        if cs.set_user_mp(TEST_USER_ID,amount=-10)!=0: fail("system amount keyword/lower clamp failed")
        refreshed=db.refresh_user_mp(TEST_USER_ID)
        if not isinstance(refreshed,int): fail("refresh_user_mp return contract failed")
        checks+=5

        non_mana=db.set_character_class(TEST_USER_ID,non_mana_key)
        if non_mana.get("success") is not True: fail("set non-mana class failed")
        if db.get_max_mp(TEST_USER_ID)!=0: fail("non-mana max MP contract failed")
        info=db.get_user_mp(TEST_USER_ID)
        if info.get("mp")!=0 or info.get("max_mp")!=0: fail("non-mana MP contract failed")
        checks+=3

        if db.get_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID)!=0 or db.has_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID): fail("initial class-change contract failed")
        if db.grant_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID)!=1: fail("single grant failed")
        if db.grant_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID,amount=2)!=3: fail("multi grant failed")
        if not db.has_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID): fail("availability boolean failed")
        if db.consume_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID) is not True: fail("consume available failed")
        if db.get_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID)!=2: fail("consume count failed")
        db.consume_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID); db.consume_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID)
        if db.consume_class_change_available(TEST_USER_ID) is not False: fail("consume at zero failed")
        checks+=7

        # Public and system signatures intentionally differ only in the second parameter name for set_user_mp.
        public_sig=str(inspect.signature(db.set_user_mp)); system_sig=str(inspect.signature(cs.set_user_mp))
        if public_sig!="(user_id, mp)" or system_sig!="(user_id, amount)": fail("set_user_mp signature contract changed")

    finally:
        cleanup()

    leftovers=db.cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE user_id IN (?,?)",(TEST_USER_ID,SECOND_USER_ID)).fetchone()[0]
    if int(leftovers or 0)!=0: fail("isolated fixture cleanup failed")
    real_after=db.cursor.execute(
        "SELECT user_id,character_name,character_class,class_change_available,mp,max_mp FROM users WHERE user_id>=0 ORDER BY user_id"
    ).fetchall()
    if [tuple(r) for r in real_before] != [tuple(r) for r in real_after]: fail("real user rows changed")

    print("[OK] character isolated mutation contracts")
    print(f"- mutation contract checks: {checks}")
    print("- name validation/uniqueness: OK")
    print("- class selection/display/resource: OK")
    print("- MP dictionary/clamp/keyword contracts: OK")
    print("- class-change grant/consume contracts: OK")
    print("- isolated fixtures cleanup: OK")
    print("- real user mutations: 0")

if __name__=="__main__": main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Structural/runtime contracts for the class-change callback hotfix."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
START = ROOT / "handlers" / "start.py"
CHARACTER = ROOT / "systems" / "character_system.py"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def main():
    start_source = START.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    start_tree = ast.parse(start_source, filename=str(START))
    character_source = CHARACTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    character_tree = ast.parse(character_source, filename=str(CHARACTER))

    change_nodes = [
        node for node in ast.walk(start_tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "change_class"
    ]
    if len(change_nodes) != 1:
        fail(f"change_class definitions={len(change_nodes)}, expected 1")
    change_source = ast.get_source_segment(start_source, change_nodes[0]) or ""

    required = (
        "isinstance(consume_result, dict)",
        "consume_success = bool(consume_result)",
        "result.get(\"class_name\")",
        "get_character_class_display(user_id)",
        "unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id)",
    )
    for marker in required:
        if marker not in change_source:
            fail(f"change_class missing marker: {marker}")
    if 'consume_result["success"]' in change_source:
        fail("unsafe dict-only consume_result access remains")
    if "result['class_name']" in change_source:
        fail("unsafe class_name indexing remains")

    consume_nodes = [
        node for node in character_tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        and node.name == "consume_class_change_available"
    ]
    if len(consume_nodes) != 1:
        fail("Character System consume function count is not 1")
    consume_source = ast.get_source_segment(character_source, consume_nodes[0]) or ""
    if "return changed" not in consume_source:
        fail("Character System consume contract is no longer bool")

    set_nodes = [
        node for node in character_tree.body
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "set_character_class"
    ]
    if len(set_nodes) != 1:
        fail("Character System set_character_class count is not 1")
    set_source = ast.get_source_segment(character_source, set_nodes[0]) or ""
    if '"class_key": key' not in set_source:
        fail("set_character_class class_key result contract missing")

    # Pure contract matrix: no DB or Telegram calls.
    samples = (
        (True, True),
        (False, False),
        ({"success": True}, True),
        ({"success": False, "message": "x"}, False),
    )
    for value, expected in samples:
        actual = bool(value.get("success")) if isinstance(value, dict) else bool(value)
        if actual is not expected:
            fail(f"consume compatibility matrix failed: {value!r}")

    print("[OK] class change handler contract hotfix")
    print("- bool consume result: supported")
    print("- historical dict consume result: supported")
    print("- class_key-only set result: supported")
    print("- incompatible equipment auto-unequip path: preserved")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TARGET = ROOT / "handlers" / "combat.py"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def main():
    source = TARGET.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(TARGET))
    names = {
        node.name for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
    }
    required_functions = {
        "_combat_extract_retry_after_11_3_1",
        "_install_combat_safe_send_11_3_1",
        "_combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1",
        "_combat_message_allowed_11_3_1",
    }
    if not required_functions.issubset(names):
        fail(f"missing helpers: {sorted(required_functions - names)}")

    required_markers = (
        "_COMBAT_CALLBACK_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS_11_3_1 = 0.90",
        "_install_combat_safe_send_11_3_1(bot)",
        'if not _combat_message_allowed_11_3_1(message):',
        'if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "attack"):',
        'if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "skill"):',
        'if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "potion"):',
        'if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "flee"):',
        'if not _combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1(bot, call, "potion_use"):',
        'if "too many requests" not in text.lower():',
        "presentation suppressed",
    )
    for marker in required_markers:
        if marker not in source:
            fail(f"missing rate-limit marker: {marker}")

    # Guards must appear before state-mutating calls in callback bodies.
    checks = {
        "combat_attack_callback": "attack(message)",
        "combat_use_skill_callback": "init_combat_effects(mob)",
        "combat_flee_callback": "escape(message)",
    }
    functions = {
        node.name: ast.get_source_segment(source, node) or ""
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
    }
    for function_name, mutation_marker in checks.items():
        block = functions.get(function_name, "")
        guard_position = block.find("_combat_callback_allowed_11_3_1")
        mutation_position = block.find(mutation_marker)
        if guard_position < 0 or mutation_position < 0 or guard_position > mutation_position:
            fail(f"{function_name}: guard is not before mutation")

    # Execute isolated helper definitions with fake time/bot objects.
    module = {}
    # Execute only the hotfix helpers. Do not execute unrelated combat.py
    # imports such as data.locations, because this smoke test must remain
    # independent of the caller's current working directory and sys.path.
    import re
    import time
    module = {
        "_combat_rate_re_11_3_1": re,
        "_combat_rate_time_11_3_1": time,
    }
    helper_nodes = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if (isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
            isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id.startswith("_COMBAT_")
            for target in node.targets
        ))
        or (isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in required_functions)
    ]
    isolated = ast.Module(body=helper_nodes, type_ignores=[])
    ast.fix_missing_locations(isolated)
    exec(compile(isolated, str(TARGET), "exec"), module)
    parser = module["_combat_extract_retry_after_11_3_1"]
    if parser("429 Too Many Requests: retry after 20") != 20:
        fail("retry_after parser failed")
    if parser("400 Bad Request") is not None:
        fail("non-429 error was misclassified")

    print("[OK] Combat callback/rate-limit hotfix contracts")
    print("- callback debounce: 0.90s")
    print("- duplicate attack/skill/flee blocked before mutation: OK")
    print("- potion menu/use callback guards: OK")
    print("- Hunt blocked during Telegram cooldown: OK")
    print("- Telegram 429 retry_after parser: OK")
    print("- stale combat messages are not retried: OK")
    print("- non-429 send exceptions remain visible: OK")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Isolated contracts for Combat Mana Potion implementation."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import hashlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
DB_PATH = ROOT / "game.db"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def fingerprint():
    return hashlib.sha256(DB_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), DB_PATH.stat().st_size, DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns


def main():
    before = fingerprint()
    from systems import potion_system as potion
    from handlers import combat

    originals = {
        "get_inventory_entry": potion.get_inventory_entry,
        "consume_inventory_item": potion.consume_inventory_item,
        "get_current_hp": potion.get_current_hp,
        "get_max_hp": potion.get_max_hp,
        "set_current_hp": potion.set_current_hp,
        "get_user_mp": potion.get_user_mp,
        "set_user_mp": potion.set_user_mp,
        "get_inventory_detailed": combat.get_inventory_detailed,
        "get_character_profile_summary": combat.get_character_profile_summary,
        "get_item_by_inventory_id_full": combat.get_item_by_inventory_id_full,
    }
    consumed = []
    written_mp = []
    written_hp = []
    entries = {
        1: (1, 202, "🔵 Мале зілля мани", "potion_mp", "potion", 2),
        2: (2, 204, "🔵 Середнє зілля мани", "potion_mp_medium", "potion", 1),
        3: (3, 201, "🔴 Мале зілля здоров’я", "potion_hp", "potion", 2),
    }
    try:
        potion.get_inventory_entry = lambda user_id, inventory_id: entries.get(inventory_id)
        potion.consume_inventory_item = lambda user_id, inventory_id, quantity: consumed.append((inventory_id, quantity)) or True
        potion.get_user_mp = lambda user_id: {"mp": 20, "max_mp": 100}
        potion.set_user_mp = lambda user_id, value: written_mp.append(value)
        potion.get_current_hp = lambda user_id: 50
        potion.get_max_hp = lambda user_id: 170
        potion.set_current_hp = lambda user_id, value: written_hp.append(value)

        small = potion.use_potion_from_inventory(-1, 1)
        if small.get("resource") != "mp" or small.get("restore_mp") != 40 or small.get("new_mp") != 60:
            fail(f"small MP contract failed: {small}")
        medium = potion.use_potion_from_inventory(-1, 2)
        if medium.get("resource") != "mp" or medium.get("restore_mp") != 80 or medium.get("new_mp") != 100:
            fail(f"medium MP clamp failed: {medium}")
        hp = potion.use_potion_from_inventory(-1, 3)
        if hp.get("resource") != "hp" or hp.get("new_hp") != 100 or hp.get("heal") != 50:
            fail(f"HP compatibility failed: {hp}")
        if consumed != [(1, 1), (2, 1), (3, 1)]:
            fail(f"consume exactly once failed: {consumed}")

        before_full = list(consumed)
        potion.get_user_mp = lambda user_id: {"mp": 100, "max_mp": 100}
        full = potion.use_potion_from_inventory(-1, 1)
        if full.get("success") is not False or consumed != before_full:
            fail("full MP must not consume potion")

        # Keyboard visibility and cooldowns.
        items = [
            (1, 202, "MP small", "potion_mp", "common", "potion", 2, 10, 100, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1.2),
            (2, 204, "MP medium", "potion_mp_medium", "common", "potion", 1, 10, 100, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,3.6),
            (3, 201, "HP small", "potion_hp", "common", "potion", 2, 10, 100, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1.0),
        ]
        combat.get_inventory_detailed = lambda user_id: items
        combat.get_character_profile_summary = lambda user_id: {"resource_type": "mana"}
        mana_kb = combat.build_combat_potion_kb(-1)
        mana_callbacks = [button.callback_data for row in mana_kb.keyboard for button in row]
        if not {"combat_potion_1", "combat_potion_2", "combat_potion_3"}.issubset(set(mana_callbacks)):
            fail(f"mana keyboard missing potions: {mana_callbacks}")
        combat.get_character_profile_summary = lambda user_id: {"resource_type": "rage"}
        nonmana_kb = combat.build_combat_potion_kb(-1)
        nonmana_callbacks = [button.callback_data for row in nonmana_kb.keyboard for button in row]
        if "combat_potion_1" in nonmana_callbacks or "combat_potion_2" in nonmana_callbacks:
            fail(f"MP potion visible to non-mana class: {nonmana_callbacks}")

        def full_item(type_):
            return (1, 999, "x", type_, "common", "potion", None, 1, 1, 10, 100, 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1.0)
        for type_, expected in (("potion_mp", 3), ("potion_mp_medium", 5), ("potion_hp", 3), ("potion_hp_medium", 5)):
            combat.get_item_by_inventory_id_full = lambda inventory_id, value=full_item(type_): value
            actual = combat.get_potion_cooldown_turns_by_inventory_id(1)
            if actual != expected:
                fail(f"cooldown {type_}={actual}, expected {expected}")

        combat_source = (ROOT / "handlers" / "combat.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        if 'resource == "mp"' not in combat_source or 'mob["player_mp"]' not in combat_source:
            fail("combat callback MP synchronization missing")
        if "Хід не витрачено" not in combat_source:
            fail("turn-free potion rule missing")
    finally:
        for name, value in originals.items():
            module = potion if hasattr(potion, name) and name in {
                "get_inventory_entry", "consume_inventory_item", "get_current_hp", "get_max_hp",
                "set_current_hp", "get_user_mp", "set_user_mp"
            } else combat
            setattr(module, name, value)

    if before != fingerprint():
        fail("game.db changed during isolated contracts")
    print("[OK] Combat Mana Potion implementation contracts")
    print("- small MP restore: 40")
    print("- medium MP restore/clamp: OK")
    print("- full mana no-consume: OK")
    print("- consume exactly once: OK")
    print("- HP potion compatibility: OK")
    print("- mana-class keyboard visibility: OK")
    print("- non-mana-class hiding: OK")
    print("- cooldown small/medium: 3/5")
    print("- combat MP state synchronization: OK")
    print("- potion use spends no turn: OK")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Contracts for shared potion cooldown menu UX."""

import ast
import hashlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
DB_PATH = ROOT / "game.db"
COMBAT_PATH = ROOT / "handlers" / "combat.py"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def fingerprint():
    return (
        hashlib.sha256(DB_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        DB_PATH.stat().st_size,
        DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns,
    )


def main():
    before = fingerprint()
    source = COMBAT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(COMBAT_PATH))
    names = {
        node.name: node
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
        if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        and node.name in {
            "format_combat_turns_uk",
            "build_combat_potion_kb",
            "choose_potion_in_combat",
            "use_selected_potion_in_combat",
        }
    }

        fail(f"required function set incomplete: {sorted(names)}")

    if "if cooldown > 0" in choose_source:

        fail("potion menu does not receive shared cooldown")
    if "if cooldown > 0" not in use_source:
        fail("potion use callback no longer blocks use during cooldown")
    if "format_combat_turns_uk(cooldown)" not in use_source:
        fail("use callback does not use Ukrainian turn pluralization")

    from handlers import combat

        0: "0 ходів",

        2: "2 ходи",

        11: "11 ходів",
        12: "12 ходів",
        21: "21 хід",
        22: "22 ходи",
    }
    for value, text in expected.items():
        actual = combat.format_combat_turns_uk(value)
        if actual != text:
            fail(f"pluralization {value}: {actual!r}, expected {text!r}")

        combat.get_inventory_detailed = original_inventory

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Read-only contracts for db.py constants canonicalization."""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import importlib
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

DB_PATH = ROOT / "game.db"
DB_PY = ROOT / "db.py"
CANONICAL_GROUPS = {
    "data.classes": (
        "CLASS_CONFIGS", "CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID",
    ),
    "data.equipment_profiles": (
        "ARMOR_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS", "ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT",
        "ARMOR_TYPE_LABELS", "EQUIPMENT_SLOTS", "ITEM_SUBTYPE_LABELS",
        "MAIN_HAND_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS", "MAIN_HAND_PROFILES",
        "OFF_HAND_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS", "OFF_HAND_PROFILES",
    ),
    "data.balance": (
        "CONTRACTS_UNLOCK_LEVEL", "CONTRACT_MOBS_EQUIVALENT",
        "CONTRACT_TARGET_KILLS", "DAILY_CONTRACT_LIMIT",
        "DAILY_QUEST_ID_KILL_MONSTERS", "DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_ID",
        "DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_QUANTITY", "DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS",
        "ENERGY_MAX", "ENERGY_REGEN_MINUTES", "HP_REGEN_MINUTES",
        "HP_REGEN_PERCENT", "RARITY_REPAIR_MULTIPLIERS",
        "REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK", "REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID",
    ),
}
ALL_CONSTANTS = tuple(name for values in CANONICAL_GROUPS.values() for name in values)


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def fingerprint():
    return (
        hashlib.sha256(DB_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        DB_PATH.stat().st_size,
        DB_PATH.stat().st_mtime_ns,
    )


def assigned_names(node):
    names = set()
    targets = node.targets if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) else [node.target]
    for target in targets:
        if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
            names.add(target.id)
    return names


def main():
    before = fingerprint()
    source = DB_PY.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(DB_PY))

    local_definitions = []
    imported = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AnnAssign)):
            overlap = assigned_names(node).intersection(ALL_CONSTANTS)
            if overlap:
                local_definitions.extend((name, node.lineno) for name in overlap)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module in CANONICAL_GROUPS:
            for alias in node.names:
                imported[alias.asname or alias.name] = node.module

    if local_definitions:
        fail(f"local duplicate definitions remain: {local_definitions}")

    missing_imports = [
        name for module, names in CANONICAL_GROUPS.items() for name in names
        if imported.get(name) != module
    ]
    if missing_imports:
        fail(f"canonical imports missing or owned by wrong module: {missing_imports}")

    import db
    identity_checks = 0
    value_checks = 0
    for module_name, names in CANONICAL_GROUPS.items():
        canonical = importlib.import_module(module_name)
        for name in names:
            if not hasattr(db, name):
                fail(f"db public constant missing: {name}")
            if not hasattr(canonical, name):
                fail(f"canonical constant missing: {module_name}.{name}")
            db_value = getattr(db, name)
            canonical_value = getattr(canonical, name)
            if db_value != canonical_value:
                fail(f"value mismatch: db.{name} != {module_name}.{name}")
            value_checks += 1
            if isinstance(canonical_value, (dict, list, set)):
                if db_value is not canonical_value:
                    fail(f"identity mismatch for mutable canonical object: {name}")
                identity_checks += 1

    required_runtime = {
        "class_name": db.get_class_display_name_by_key("mage"),
        "armor_label": db.get_armor_type_label("cloth"),
        "subtype_label": db.get_item_subtype_label("sword_1h"),
        "repair_multiplier": db.get_rarity_repair_multiplier("epic"),
        "contract_exp": db.get_contract_exp_for_level(10),
    }
    if not required_runtime["class_name"] or not required_runtime["armor_label"]:
        fail(f"runtime helper output invalid: {required_runtime}")

    if before != fingerprint():
        fail("game.db changed during read-only contracts")

    print("[OK] constants canonicalization contracts")
    print(f"- local duplicate definitions: {len(local_definitions)}")
    print(f"- canonical imports verified: {value_checks}")
    print(f"- mutable object identity checks: {identity_checks}")
    print(f"- public db constant surface preserved: {len(ALL_CONSTANTS)}")
    print(f"- runtime helper probes: {required_runtime}")
    print("- database mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Post-i10c isolated contracts for the final Contract Reward facade."""
from __future__ import annotations
import ast
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

import db

IDS = (-90121021, -90121022, -90121023)
CAPTURE = "_base_claim_contract_reward_before_guild_reward_v1"


def fail(message):
    print(f"[FAIL] {message}")
    raise SystemExit(1)


def columns(table):
    return [row[1] for row in db.conn.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{table}")').fetchall()]


def user_tables():
    result = []
    for (name,) in db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
    ).fetchall():
        try:
            if "user_id" in columns(name):
                result.append(name)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return result


def cleanup():
    for table in [name for name in user_tables() if name != "users"]:
        for user_id in IDS:
            try:
                db.conn.execute(f'DELETE FROM "{table}" WHERE user_id=?', (user_id,))
            except Exception:
                pass
    for user_id in IDS:
        try:
            db.conn.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
        except Exception:
            pass
    db.conn.commit()


def real_snapshot():
    cols = columns("users")
    select_list = ",".join(f'"{name}"' for name in cols)
    rows = [
        tuple(row)
        for row in db.conn.execute(
            f"SELECT {select_list} FROM users WHERE user_id>=0 ORDER BY user_id"
        ).fetchall()
    ]
    return cols, rows


def create_fixture(user_id, completed, current_kills=0, reward_exp=40):
    db.create_user(user_id)
    db.init_contract_system()
    db.conn.execute(
        "UPDATE users SET level=5, exp=0, daily_contracts_completed=0, daily_contract_date=? WHERE user_id=?",
        (db.get_today_str(), user_id),
    )
    db.conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO user_active_contracts (
        user_id, created_date, player_level, target_mob_name, target_mob_level,
        target_min_level, target_max_level, target_kills, current_kills,
        reward_exp, completed, reward_claimed
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
        (
            user_id, db.get_today_str(), 5, "fixture_target", 5,
            1, 10, 5, current_kills, reward_exp, completed, 0,
        ),
    )
    db.conn.commit()


def state(user_id):
    user = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT level, exp, daily_contracts_completed FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    contract_count = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_active_contracts WHERE user_id=?",
        (user_id,),
    ).fetchone()[0]
    return tuple(user), int(contract_count)


def main():
    source = (ROOT / "db.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(ROOT / "db.py"))
    definitions = [
        node for node in tree.body
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
        and node.name == "claim_contract_reward"
    ]
    if len(definitions) != 1:
        fail(f"claim_contract_reward definitions={len(definitions)}, expected 1 after i10c")

    final_source = ast.get_source_segment(source, definitions[0]) or ""
    if "systems.contract_system" not in final_source:
        fail("final db.claim_contract_reward is not a Contract System facade")
    if CAPTURE in source or hasattr(db, CAPTURE):
        fail("obsolete Contract Reward capture still exists")
    for helper in (
        "_guild_contract_reward_result_success_v1",
        "_guild_contract_reward_append_message_v1",
    ):
        if helper in source or hasattr(db, helper):
            fail(f"obsolete helper still exists: {helper}")

    before = real_snapshot()
    cleanup()
    checks = 0
    original_award = db.award_guild_contract_completion
    original_text = db.get_guild_activity_reward_text
    guild_calls = []

    try:
        missing = db.claim_contract_reward(IDS[0])
        if not isinstance(missing, dict) or missing.get("success") is not False:
            fail(f"missing-contract result failed: {missing!r}")
        checks += 1

        create_fixture(IDS[0], completed=0, current_kills=2)
        incomplete_before = state(IDS[0])
        incomplete = db.claim_contract_reward(IDS[0])
        incomplete_after = state(IDS[0])
        if incomplete.get("success") is not False or incomplete_before != incomplete_after:
            fail("incomplete contract changed state")
        checks += 1

        create_fixture(IDS[1], completed=1, current_kills=5, reward_exp=40)

        def fake_award(user_id, contract=None):
            guild_calls.append((user_id, contract))
            return {"success": True, "exp": 50, "resource": 3, "contracts": 1}

        def fake_text(result):
            return "🏰 Fixture Guild reward"

        db.award_guild_contract_completion = fake_award
        db.get_guild_activity_reward_text = fake_text

        completed = db.claim_contract_reward(IDS[1])
        completed_state = state(IDS[1])
        if completed.get("success") is not True:
            fail(f"completed result failed: {completed!r}")
        if int(completed.get("reward_exp", 0)) != 40:
            fail(f"reward_exp mismatch: {completed!r}")
        if completed_state[0][2] != 1 or completed_state[1] != 0:
            fail(f"completed state invalid: {completed_state!r}")
        if len(guild_calls) != 1 or guild_calls[0][0] != IDS[1]:
            fail(f"Guild hook calls invalid: {guild_calls!r}")
        if "Fixture Guild reward" not in str(completed.get("message") or ""):
            fail("Guild reward text was not appended")
        checks += 5

        repeat_before = state(IDS[1])
        repeat = db.claim_contract_reward(IDS[1])
        repeat_after = state(IDS[1])
        if repeat.get("success") is not False:
            fail(f"repeat claim unexpectedly succeeded: {repeat!r}")
        if repeat_before != repeat_after or len(guild_calls) != 1:
            fail("repeat reward protection failed")
        checks += 1

        # Real no-guild path: guild helper must fail safely without changing claim result.
        create_fixture(IDS[2], completed=1, current_kills=5, reward_exp=40)
        db.award_guild_contract_completion = original_award
        db.get_guild_activity_reward_text = original_text
        no_guild = db.claim_contract_reward(IDS[2])
        if no_guild.get("success") is not True or state(IDS[2])[1] != 0:
            fail(f"no-guild completed claim failed: {no_guild!r}")
        checks += 1

    finally:
        db.award_guild_contract_completion = original_award
        db.get_guild_activity_reward_text = original_text
        cleanup()

    if before != real_snapshot():
        fail("real users changed")

    print("[OK] contract reward final post-cleanup contracts")
    print(f"- contract checks: {checks}")
    print("- single public facade: OK")
    print("- obsolete capture/helpers: absent")
    print("- missing/incomplete paths: OK")
    print("- EXP and daily completion: OK")
    print("- active contract deletion: OK")
    print("- Guild hook exactly once: OK")
    print("- no-guild path: OK")
    print("- repeat reward protection: OK")
    print("- fixture cleanup: OK")
    print("- real user mutations: 0")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
